11.2: For, look! the wicked ones themselves bend the bow, They do make ready their arrow upon the bowstring, To shoot in the gloom at the ones upright in heart.
11.3: When the foundations themselves are torn down, What must anyone righteous do?
11.4: Jehovah is in his holy temple. Jehovah - in the heavens is his throne. His own eyes behold, his own beaming eyes examine the sons of men.
11.5: Jehovah himself examines the righteous one as well as the wicked one, And anyone loving violence His soul certainly hates.
11.6: He will rain down upon the wicked ones traps, fire and sulphur And a scorching wind, as the portion of their cup.
11.7: For Jehovah is righteous; he does love righteous acts. The upright are the ones that will behold his face.

12.1: Do save I [ me], O Jehovah, for the loyal one has come to an end; For faithful people have vanished from the sons of men.
12.2: Untruth they keep speaking one to the other; With a smooth lip they keep speaking even with a double heart.
12.3: Jehovah will cut off all smooth lips, The tongue speaking great things,
12.4: Those who have said: " With our tongue we shall prevail. Our lips are with us. Who will be a master to us? "
12.5: " Because of the despoiling of the afflicted ones, because of the sighing of the poor ones, I shall at this time arise, " says Jehovah. " I shall put I [ him] in safety from anyone that puffs at him. "
12.6: The sayings of Jehovah are pure sayings, As silver refined in a smelting furnace of earth, clarified seven times.
12.7: You yourself, O Jehovah, will guard them; You will preserve each one from this generation to time indefinite.
12.8: The wicked ones walk all around, Because vileness is exalted among the sons of men.

13.1: How long, O Jehovah, will you forget me? Forever? How long will you conceal your face from me?
13.2: How long shall I set resistance in my soul, Grief in my heart by day? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
13.3: Do look I [ upon me]; answer me, O Jehovah my God. Do make my eyes shine, that I may not fall asleep in death,
13.4: That my enemy may not say: " I have won out over him! " I [ That] my adversaries themselves may I [ not] be joyful because I am made to stagger.
13.5: As for me, in your loving - kindness I have trusted; Let my heart be joyful in your salvation.
13.6: I will sing to Jehovah, for he has dealt rewardingly with me.

14.1: The senseless one has said in his heart: " There is no Jehovah. " They have acted ruinously, they have acted detestably in I [ their] dealing. There is no one doing good.
14.2: As for Jehovah, he has looked down from heaven itself upon the sons of men, To see whether there exists anyone having insight, anyone seeking Jehovah.
14.3: They have all turned aside, they are I [ all] alike corrupt; There is no one doing good, Not even one.
14.4: Have none of the practicers of what is hurtful got knowledge, Eating up my people as they have eaten bread? They have not called even upon Jehovah.
14.5: There they were filled with a great dread, For Jehovah is among the generation of the righteous one.
14.6: The counsel of the afflicted one YOU people would put to shame, Because Jehovah is his refuge.
14.7: O that out of Zion there were the salvation of Israel! When Jehovah gathers back the captive ones of his people, Let Jacob be joyful, let Israel rejoice.

15.1: O Jehovah, who will be a guest in your tent? Who will reside in your holy mountain?
15.2: He who is walking faultlessly and practicing righteousness And speaking the truth in his heart.
15.3: He has not slandered with his tongue. To his companion he has done nothing bad, And no reproach has he taken up against his intimate acquaintance.
15.4: In his eyes anyone contemptible is certainly rejected, But those fearing Jehovah he honors. He has sworn to what is bad I [ for himself], and yet he does not alter.
15.5: His money he has not given out on interest, And a bribe against the innocent one he has not taken. He that is doing these things will never be made to totter.

16.1: Keep me, O God, for I have taken refuge in you.
16.2: I have said to Jehovah: " You are Jehovah; my goodness is, not for your sake,
16.3: I [ But] to the holy ones that are in the earth. They, even the majestic ones, are the ones in whom is all my delight. "
16.4: Pains become many to those I [ who], when there is someone else, do hurry I [ after him]. I shall not pour out their drink offerings of blood, And I shall not carry their names upon my lips.
16.5: Jehovah is the portion of my allotted share and of my cup. You are holding fast my lot.
16.6: The measuring lines themselves have fallen for me in pleasant places. Really, I [ my own] possession has proved agreeable to me.
16.7: I shall bless Jehovah, who has given me advice. Really, during the nights my kidneys have corrected me.
16.8: I have placed Jehovah in front of me constantly. Because I [ he] is at my right hand, I shall not be made to totter.
16.9: Therefore my heart does rejoice, and my glory is inclined to be joyful. Also, my own flesh will reside in security.
16.10: For you will not leave my soul in She'ol. You will not allow your loyal one to see the pit.
16.11: You will cause me to know the path of life. Rejoicing to satisfaction is with your face; There is pleasantness at your right hand forever.

17.1: Do hear what is righteous, O Jehovah; do pay attention to my entreating cry; Do give ear to my prayer without lips of deception.
17.2: From before you may my judgment go forth; May your own eyes behold uprightness.
17.3: You have examined my heart, you have made inspection by night, You have refined me; you will discover I [ that] I have not schemed. My mouth will not transgress.
17.4: As for the activities of men, By the word of your lips I myself have watched against the paths of the robber.
17.5: Let my steps take hold on your tracks, I [ In which] my footsteps will certainly not be made to totter.
17.6: I myself do call upon you, because you will answer me, O God. Incline your ear to me. Hear my saying.
17.7: Make your acts of loving - kindnesses wonderful, O Savior of those seeking refuge From the revolters against your right hand.
17.8: Keep me as the pupil of the eyeball, In the shadow of your wings may you conceal me,
17.9: Because of the wicked who have despoiled me. The enemies against my soul themselves keep closing in upon me.
17.10: They have enclosed I [ themselves] with their own fat; With their mouth they have spoken in haughtiness;
17.11: As regards our steps, now they have surrounded us; They fix their eyes to incline to the earth.
17.12: His likeness is that of a lion that yearns to tear to pieces And that of a young lion sitting in concealed places.
17.13: Do rise up, O Jehovah; do confront him to the face; Make him bow down; do provide escape for my soul from the wicked one with your sword,
17.14: From men, I [ by] your hand, O Jehovah, From men of I [ this] system of things, whose share is in I [ this] life, And whose belly you fill with your concealed treasure, Who are satisfied with sons And who do lay up for their children what they leave over.
17.15: As for me, in righteousness I shall behold your face; I will be satisfied when awakening I [ to see] your form.

18.1: I shall have affection for you, O Jehovah my strength.
18.2: Jehovah is my crag and my stronghold and the Provider of escape for me. My God is my rock. I shall take refuge in him, My shield and my horn of salvation, my secure height.
18.3: On the One to be praised, Jehovah, I shall call, And from my enemies I shall be saved.
18.4: The ropes of death encircled me; Flash floods of good - for - nothing I [ men] also kept terrifying me.
18.5: The very ropes of She'ol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
18.6: In my distress I kept calling upon Jehovah, And to my God I kept crying for help. Out of his temple he proceeded to hear my voice, And my own cry before him for help now came into his ears.
18.7: And the earth began to shake and rock, And the foundations of the mountains themselves became agitated, And they kept shaking back and forth because he had been angered.
18.8: Smoke went up at his nostrils, and fire itself from his mouth kept devouring; Coals themselves blazed forth from him.
18.9: And he proceeded to bend the heavens down and descend. And thick gloom was beneath his feet.
18.10: And he came riding upon a cherub and came flying, And he came darting upon the wings of a spirit.
18.11: He then made darkness his concealment place, All around him as his booth, Dark waters, thick clouds.
18.12: Out of the brightness in front of him there were his clouds that passed by, Hail and burning coals of fire.
18.13: And in the heavens Jehovah began to thunder, And the Most High himself began to give his voice, Hail and burning coals of fire.
18.14: And he kept sending out his arrows, that he might scatter them; And lightnings he shot out, that he might throw them into confusion.
18.15: And the streambeds of waters became visible, And the foundations of the productive land became uncovered From your rebuke, O Jehovah, from the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
18.16: He was sending from on high, he was taking me, He was drawing me out of great waters.
18.17: He was delivering me from my strong enemy, And from those hating me; because they were stronger than I was.
18.18: They kept confronting me in the day of my disaster, But Jehovah came to be as a support for me.
18.19: And he proceeded to bring me out into a roomy place; He was rescuing me, because he had found delight in me.
18.20: Jehovah rewards me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands he repays me.
18.21: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And I have not wickedly departed from my God.
18.22: For all his judicial decisions are in front of me, And his statutes I shall not remove from myself.
18.23: And I will prove myself faultless with him, And I shall keep myself from error on my part.
18.24: And let Jehovah repay me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in front of his eyes.
18.25: With someone loyal you will act in loyalty; With the faultless, able - bodied man you will deal faultlessly;
18.26: With the one keeping clean you will show yourself clean; And with the crooked one you will show yourself tortuous;
18.27: Because the afflicted people you yourself will save; But the haughty eyes you will abase.
18.28: For you yourself will light my lamp, O Jehovah; My God himself will make my darkness shine.
18.29: For by you I can run against a marauder band; And by my God I can climb a wall.
18.30: As for the I [ true] God, perfect is his way; The saying of Jehovah is a refined one. A shield he is to all those taking refuge in him.
18.31: For who is a God besides Jehovah? And who is a rock except our God?
18.32: The I [ true] God is the One girding me closely with vital energy, And he will grant my way to be perfect,
18.33: Making my feet like those of the hinds, And upon places high for me he keeps me standing.
18.34: He is teaching my hands for warfare, And my arms have pressed down a bow of copper.
18.35: And you will give me your shield of salvation, And your own right hand will sustain me, And your own humility will make me great.
18.36: You will make room large enough for my steps under me, And my ankles will certainly not wobble.
18.37: I shall pursue my enemies and overtake them; And I shall not return until they are exterminated.
18.38: I shall break them in pieces so that they will not be able to rise up; They will fall under my feet.
18.39: And you will gird me with vital energy for warfare; You will make those rising against me collapse under me.
18.40: And as for my enemies, you will certainly give me the back of I [ their] neck; And as for those hating me intensely, I shall silence them.
18.41: They cry for help, but there is no savior, To Jehovah, but he actually does not answer them.
18.42: And I shall pound them fine like dust before the wind; Like the mire of the streets I shall pour them out.
18.43: You will provide me escape from the faultfinding of the people. You will appoint me the head of the nations. A people that I have not known - they will serve me.
18.44: At mere hearsay they will be obedient to me; Foreigners themselves will come cringing to me.
18.45: Foreigners themselves will fade away, And they will come quaking out from their bulwarks.
18.46: Jehovah is living, and blessed be my Rock, And let the God of my salvation be exalted.
18.47: The I [ true] God is the Giver of acts of vengeance to me; And he subdues the peoples under me.
18.48: He is providing escape for me from my angry enemies; Above those who rise up against me you will lift me up, From the man of violence you will deliver me.
18.49: That is why I shall laud you among the nations, O Jehovah, And to your name I will make melody.
18.50: He is doing great acts of salvation for his king And exercising loving - kindness to his anointed one, To David and to his seed to time indefinite.

19.1: The heavens are declaring the glory of God; And of the work of his hands the expanse is telling.
19.2: One day after another day causes speech to bubble forth, And one night after another night shows forth knowledge.
19.3: There is no speech, and there are no words; No voice on their part is being heard.
19.4: Into all the earth their measuring line has gone out, And to the extremity of the productive land their utterances. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
19.5: And it is like a bridegroom when coming out of his nuptial chamber; It exults as a mighty man does to run in a path.
19.6: From one extremity of the heavens is its going forth, And its I [ finished] circuit is to their I [ other] extremities; And there is nothing concealed from its heat.
19.7: The law of Jehovah is perfect, bringing back the soul. The reminder of Jehovah is trustworthy, making the inexperienced one wise.
19.8: The orders from Jehovah are upright, causing the heart to rejoice; The commandment of Jehovah is clean, making the eyes shine.
19.9: The fear of Jehovah is pure, standing forever. The judicial decisions of Jehovah are true; they have proved altogether righteous.
19.10: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much refined gold; And sweeter than honey and the flowing honey of the combs.
19.11: Also, your own servant has been warned by them; In the keeping of them there is a large reward.
19.12: Mistakes - who can discern? From concealed sins pronounce me innocent.
19.13: Also from presumptuous acts hold your servant back; Do not let them dominate me. In that case I shall be complete, And I shall have remained innocent from much transgression.
19.14: Let the sayings of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Become pleasurable before you, O Jehovah my Rock and my Redeemer.

20.1: May Jehovah answer you in the day of distress. May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
20.2: May he send your help out of the holy place, And sustain you out of Zion itself.
20.3: May he remember all your gift offerings, And may he accept your burnt offering as being fat. Se'lah.
20.4: May he give to you according to your heart, And all your counsel may he fulfill.
20.5: We will cry out joyfully because of your salvation, And in the name of our God we shall lift our banners. May Jehovah fulfill all your requests.
20.6: Now I do know that Jehovah certainly saves his anointed one. He answers him from his holy heavens With the saving mighty acts of his right hand.
20.7: Some concerning chariots and others concerning horses, But, as for us, concerning the name of Jehovah our God we shall make mention.
20.8: Those very ones have broken down and fallen; But as for us, we have risen up, that we may be restored.
20.9: O Jehovah, do save the king! He will answer us in the day that we call.

21.1: O Jehovah, in your strength the king rejoices; And in your salvation how very joyful he wants to be!
21.2: The desire of his heart you have given him, And the wish of his lips you have not withheld. Se'lah.
21.3: For you proceeded to meet him with blessings of good, I [ And] to place on his head a crown of refined gold.
21.4: Life he asked of you. You gave I [ it] to him, Length of days to time indefinite, even forever.
21.5: His glory is great in your salvation. Dignity and splendor you put upon him.
21.6: For you constitute him highly blessed forever; You make him feel glad with the rejoicing at your face.
21.7: For the king is trusting in Jehovah, Even in the loving - kindness of the Most High. He will not be caused to totter.
21.8: Your hand will find all your enemies; Your own right hand will find those hating you.
21.9: You will constitute them as a fiery furnace at the appointed time for your attention. Jehovah in his anger will swallow them up, and the fire will devour them.
21.10: Their fruitage you will destroy from the very earth, And their offspring from the sons of men.
21.11: For they have directed against you what is bad; They have thought out ideas that they are unable to carry out.
21.12: For you will make them turn their backs in flight By your bowstrings that you make ready against their face.
21.13: O be exalted in your strength, O Jehovah. We will sing and make melody to your mightiness.

22.1: My God, my God, why have you left me? I [ Why are you] far from saving me, I [ From] the words of my roaring?
22.2: O my God, I keep calling by day, and you do not answer; And by night, and there is no silence on my part.
22.3: But you are holy, Inhabiting the praises of Israel.
22.4: In you our fathers trusted; They trusted, and you kept providing them with escape.
22.5: To you they cried out, and they got away safe; In you they trusted, and they did not come to shame.
22.6: But I am a worm, and not a man, A reproach to men and despicable to the people.
22.7: As for all those seeing me, they hold me in derision; They keep opening their mouths wide, they keep wagging I [ their] head:
22.8: " He committed himself to Jehovah. Let Him provide him with escape! Let him deliver him, since he has taken delight in him! "
22.9: For you were the One drawing me forth from the belly, The One making me trust while upon the breasts of my mother.
22.10: Upon you I have been thrown from the womb; From the belly of my mother you have been my God.
22.11: Do not keep far off from me, because distress is nearby, Because there is no other helper.
22.12: Many young bulls have surrounded me; The powerful ones of Ba'shan themselves have got around me.
22.13: They have opened against me their mouth, As a lion tearing in pieces and roaring.
22.14: Like water I have been poured out, And all my bones have been separated from one another. My heart has become like wax; It has melted deep in my inward parts.
22.15: My power has dried up just like a fragment of earthenware, And my tongue is made to stick to my gums; And in the dust of death you are setting me.
22.16: For dogs have surrounded me; The assembly of evildoers themselves have enclosed me. Like a lion I [ they are at] my hands and my feet.
22.17: I can count all my bones. They themselves look, they gaze upon me.
22.18: They apportion my garments among themselves, And upon my clothing they cast lots.
22.19: But you, O Jehovah, O do not keep far off. O you my strength, do make haste to my assistance.
22.20: Do deliver from the sword my soul, My only one from the very paw of the dog;
22.21: Save me from the mouth of the lion, And from the horns of wild bulls you must answer I [ and save] me.
22.22: I will declare your name to my brothers; In the middle of the congregation I shall praise you.
22.23: YOU fearers of Jehovah, praise him! All YOU the seed of Jacob, glorify him! And be frightened at him, all YOU the seed of Israel.
22.24: For he has neither despised Nor loathed the affliction of the afflicted one; And he has not concealed his face from him, And when he cried to him for help he heard.
22.25: From you my praise will be in the large congregation; My vows I shall pay in front of those fearing him.
22.26: The meek ones will eat and be satisfied; Those seeking him will praise Jehovah. May YOUR hearts live forever.
22.27: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn back to Jehovah. And all the families of the nations will bow down before you.
22.28: For the kingship belongs to Jehovah, And he is dominating the nations.
22.29: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and will bow down; Before him all those going down to the dust will bend down, And no one will ever preserve his own soul alive.
22.30: A seed itself will serve him; It will be declared concerning Jehovah to the generation.
22.31: They will come and tell of his righteousness To the people that is to be born, that he has done I [ this].

23.1: Jehovah is my Shepherd. I shall lack nothing.
23.2: In grassy pastures he makes me lie down; By well - watered resting - places he conducts me.
23.3: My soul he refreshes. He leads me in the tracks of righteousness for his name's sake.
23.4: Even though I walk in the valley of deep shadow, I fear nothing bad, For you are with me; Your rod and your staff are the things that comfort me.
23.5: You arrange before me a table in front of those showing hostility to me. With oil you have greased my head; My cup is well filled.
23.6: Surely goodness and loving - kindness themselves will pursue me all the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of Jehovah to the length of days.

24.1: To Jehovah belong the earth and that which fills it, The productive land and those dwelling in it.
24.2: For upon the seas he himself has solidly fixed it, And upon the rivers he keeps it firmly established.
24.3: Who may ascend into the mountain of Jehovah, And who may rise up in his holy place?
24.4: Anyone innocent in his hands and clean in heart, Who has not carried My soul to sheer worthlessness, Nor taken an oath deceitfully.
24.5: He will carry away blessing from Jehovah And righteousness from his God of salvation.
24.6: This is the generation of those seeking him, Of those searching for your face, O I [ God of] Jacob. Se'lah.
24.7: Raise YOUR heads, O YOU gates, And raise yourselves up, O YOU long - lasting entrances, That the glorious King may come in!
24.8: Who, then, is this glorious King? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.
24.9: Raise YOUR heads, O YOU gates; Yes, raise I [ them] up, O YOU long - lasting entrances, That the glorious King may come in!
24.10: Who, then, is he, this glorious King? Jehovah of armies - he is the glorious King. Se'lah.

25.1: To you, O Jehovah, I raise my very soul.
25.2: O my God, in you have I put my trust; O may I not be ashamed. May my enemies not exult over me.
25.3: Also, none of those hoping in you will be ashamed. They will be ashamed who are dealing treacherously without success.
25.4: Make me know your own ways, O Jehovah; Teach me your own paths.
25.5: Make me walk in your truth and teach me, For you are my God of salvation. In you I have hoped all day long.
25.6: Remember your mercies, O Jehovah, and your loving - kindnesses, For they are from time indefinite.
25.7: The sins of my youth and my revolts O do not remember. According to your loving - kindness do you yourself remember me, For the sake of your goodness, O Jehovah.
25.8: Good and upright is Jehovah. That is why he instructs sinners in the way.
25.9: He will cause the meek ones to walk in I [ his] judicial decision, And he will teach the meek ones his way.
25.10: All the paths of Jehovah are loving - kindness and trueness For those observing his covenant and his reminders.
25.11: For your name's sake, O Jehovah, You must even forgive my error, for it is considerable.
25.12: Who, now, is the man fearful of Jehovah? He will instruct him in the way I [ that] he will choose.
25.13: His own soul will lodge in goodness itself, And his own offspring will take possession of the earth.
25.14: The intimacy with Jehovah belongs to those fearful of him, Also his covenant, to cause them to know it.
25.15: My eyes are constantly toward Jehovah, For he it is that brings my feet out of the net.
25.16: Turn your face to me, and show me favor; For I am solitary and afflicted.
25.17: Distresses of my heart have multiplied; From the stresses upon me O bring me out.
25.18: See my affliction and my trouble, And pardon all my sins.
25.19: See how many my enemies have become, And with a violent hatred they have hated me.
25.20: Do guard my soul and deliver me. May I not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in you.
25.21: Let integrity and uprightness themselves safeguard me, For I have hoped in you.
25.22: O God, redeem Israel out of all his distresses.

26.1: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I myself have walked in my own integrity, And in Jehovah I have trusted, that I may not wobble.
26.2: Examine me, O Jehovah, and put me to the test; Refine my kidneys and my heart.
26.3: For your loving - kindness is in front of my eyes, And I have walked in your truth.
26.4: I have not sat with men of untruth; And with those who hide what they are I do not come in.
26.5: I have hated the congregation of evildoers, And with the wicked ones I do not sit.
26.6: I shall wash my hands in innocency itself, And I will march around your altar, O Jehovah,
26.7: To cause thanksgiving to be heard aloud, And to declare all your wonderful works.
26.8: Jehovah, I have loved the dwelling of your house And the place of the residing of your glory.
26.9: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, Nor my life along with bloodguilty men,
26.10: In whose hands there is loose conduct, And whose right hand is full of bribery.
26.11: As for me, in my integrity I shall walk. O redeem me and show me favor.
26.12: My own foot will certainly stand on a level place; Among the congregated throngs I shall bless Jehovah.

27.1: Jehovah is my light and my salvation. Of whom shall I be in fear? Jehovah is the stronghold of my life. Of whom shall I be in dread?
27.2: When the evildoers approached against me to eat up my flesh, They being my adversaries and my enemies personally, They themselves stumbled and fell.
27.3: Though against me an encampment should pitch tent, My heart will not fear. Though against me war should rise, Even then I shall be trusting.
27.4: One thing I have asked from Jehovah - It is what I shall look for, That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the pleasantness of Jehovah And to look with appreciation upon his temple.
27.5: For he will hide me in his covert in the day of calamity; He will conceal me in the secret place of his tent; High on a rock he will put me.
27.6: And now my head will be high above my enemies all around me; And I will sacrifice at his tent sacrifices of joyful shouting; I will sing and make melody to Jehovah.
27.7: Hear, O Jehovah, when I call with my voice, And show me favor and answer me.
27.8: Concerning you my heart has said: " Seek to find my face, YOU people. " Your face, O Jehovah, I shall seek to find.
27.9: Do not conceal your face from me. Do not in anger turn your servant away. My assistance you must become. Do not forsake me and do not leave me, O my God of salvation.
27.10: In case my own father and my own mother did leave me, Even Jehovah himself would take me up.
27.11: Instruct me, O Jehovah, in your way, And lead me in the path of uprightness on account of my foes.
27.12: Do not give me over to the soul of my adversaries; For against me false witnesses have risen up, And he who launches forth violence.
27.13: If I had not had faith in seeing the goodness of Jehovah in the land of those alive -!
27.14: Hope in Jehovah; be courageous and let your heart be strong. Yes, hope in Jehovah.

28.1: To you, O Jehovah, I keep calling. O my Rock, do not be deaf to me, That you may not keep still toward me And I do not have to become like those going down to the pit.
28.2: Hear the voice of my entreaties when I cry to you for help, When I raise my hands to the innermost room of your holy place.
28.3: Do not draw me along with wicked people and with practicers of what is hurtful, Those who are speaking peace with their companions but in whose hearts is what is bad.
28.4: Give to them according to their acting And according to the badness of their practices. According to the work of their hands do you give to them. Pay back to them their own doing.
28.5: For they have no regard for the activities of Jehovah, Nor for the work of his hands. He will tear them down and not build them up.
28.6: Blessed be Jehovah, for he has heard the voice of my entreaties.
28.7: Jehovah is my strength and my shield. In him my heart has trusted, And I have been helped, so that my heart exults, And with my song I shall laud him.
28.8: Jehovah is a strength to his people, And he is a stronghold of the grand salvation of his anointed one.
28.9: Do save your people, and bless your inheritance; And shepherd them and carry them to time indefinite.

29.1: Ascribe to Jehovah, O YOU sons of strong ones, Ascribe to Jehovah glory and strength.
29.2: Ascribe to Jehovah the glory of his name. Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment.
29.3: The voice of Jehovah is over the waters; The glorious God himself has thundered. Jehovah is over many waters.
29.4: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is splendid.
29.5: The voice of Jehovah is breaking the cedars; Yes, Jehovah breaks the cedars of Leb'a·non in pieces,
29.6: And he makes them skip about like a calf, Leb'a·non and Sir'i·on like the sons of wild bulls.
29.7: The voice of Jehovah is hewing with the flames of fire;
29.8: The voice of Jehovah itself makes the wilderness writhe, Jehovah makes the wilderness of Ka'desh writhe.
29.9: The voice of Jehovah itself makes the hinds writhe with birth pains And strips bare the forests. And in his temple each one is saying: " Glory! "
29.10: Upon the deluge Jehovah has seated himself; And Jehovah sits as king to time indefinite.
29.11: Jehovah himself will give strength indeed to his people. Jehovah himself will bless his people with peace.

30.1: I shall exalt you, O Jehovah, for you have drawn me up And you have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
30.2: O Jehovah my God, I cried to you for help, and you proceeded to heal me.
30.3: O Jehovah, you have brought up my soul from She'ol itself; You have kept me alive, that I should not go down into the pit.
30.4: Make melody to Jehovah, O YOU loyal ones of his, Give thanks to his holy memorial;
30.5: Because being under his anger is for a moment, Being under his goodwill is for a lifetime. In the evening weeping may take up lodging, but in the morning there is a joyful cry.
30.6: As for me, I have said in my ease: " Never shall I be made to totter. "
30.7: O Jehovah, in your goodwill you have made my mountain to stand in strength. You concealed your face; I became one that is disturbed.
30.8: To you, O Jehovah, I kept calling; And to Jehovah I kept making entreaty for favor.
30.9: What profit is there in my blood when I go down to the pit? Will the dust laud you? Will it tell of your trueness?
30.10: Hear, O Jehovah, and show me favor. O Jehovah, prove yourself my helper.
30.11: You have changed my mourning into dancing for me; You have loosened my sackcloth, and you keep me girded with rejoicing,
30.12: In order that I [ my] glory may make melody to you and not keep silent. O Jehovah my God, to time indefinite I will laud you.

31.1: In you, O Jehovah, have I taken refuge. O may I never be ashamed. In your righteousness provide escape for me.
31.2: Incline to me your ear. Deliver me speedily. Become for me a rocky stronghold, A house of strongholds to save me.
31.3: For you are my crag and my stronghold; And for the sake of your name you will lead me and conduct me.
31.4: You will bring me out of the net that they have hidden for me, For you are my fortress.
31.5: Into your hand I entrust my spirit. You have redeemed me, O Jehovah the God of truth.
31.6: I do hate those paying regard to worthless, vain idols; But as for me, in Jehovah I do trust.
31.7: I will be joyful and rejoice in your loving - kindness, In that you have seen my affliction; You have known about the distresses of my soul,
31.8: And you have not surrendered me into the hand of the enemy. You have made my feet stand in a roomy place.
31.9: Show me favor, O Jehovah, for I am in sore straits. With vexation my eye has become weak, my soul and my belly.
31.10: For with grief my life has come to an end, And my years in sighing. Because of my error my power has stumbled, And my very bones have become weak.
31.11: From the standpoint of all those showing hostility to me I have become a reproach, And to my neighbors very much so, And a dread to my acquaintances. When seeing me out of doors, they have fled from me.
31.12: Like someone dead I [ and] not in the heart, I have been forgotten; I have become like a damaged vessel;
31.13: For I have heard the bad report by many, Fright being on all sides. When they mass together as one against me, It is to take away my soul that they do scheme.
31.14: But I - in you I have put my trust, O Jehovah. I have said: " You are my God. "
31.15: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from those pursuing me.
31.16: Do cause your face to shine upon your servant. Save me in your loving - kindness.
31.17: O Jehovah, may I not be ashamed, for I have called on you. May the wicked ones be ashamed; May they keep silent in She'ol.
31.18: May false lips become speechless, That are speaking against the righteous one, unrestrainedly in haughtiness and contempt.
31.19: How abundant your goodness is, which you have treasured up for those fearing you! I [ Which] you have rendered to those taking refuge in you, In front of the sons of men.
31.20: You will conceal them in the secret place of your person From the banding together of men. You will hide them in your booth from the quarreling of tongues.
31.21: Blessed be Jehovah, For he has rendered wonderful loving - kindness to me in a city under stress.
31.22: As for me, I said when I became panicky: " I shall certainly be exterminated from in front of your eyes. " Surely you have heard the voice of my entreaties when I cried to you for help.
31.23: O love Jehovah, all YOU loyal ones of his. The faithful ones Jehovah is safeguarding, But he is rewarding exceedingly anyone showing haughtiness.
31.24: Be courageous, and may YOUR heart be strong, All YOU who are waiting for Jehovah.

32.1: Happy is the one whose revolt is pardoned, whose sin is covered.
32.2: Happy is the man to whose account Jehovah does not put error, And in whose spirit there is no deceit.
32.3: When I kept silent my bones wore out through my groaning all day long.
32.4: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me. My life's moisture has been changed as in the dry heat of summer. Se'lah.
32.5: My sin I finally confessed to you, and my error I did not cover. I said: " I shall make confession over my transgressions to Jehovah. " And you yourself pardoned the error of my sins. Se'lah.
32.6: On this account every loyal one will pray to you At such a time only as you may be found. As for the flood of many waters, they will not touch him himself.
32.7: You are a place of concealment for me; you will safeguard me from distress itself. With joyful cries at providing escape you will surround me. Se'lah.
32.8: " I shall make you have insight and instruct you in the way you should go. I will give advice with my eye upon you.
32.9: Do not make yourselves like a horse or mule without understanding, Whose spiritedness is to be curbed even by bridle or halter Before I [ they] will come near to you. "
32.10: Many are the pains that the wicked one has; But as for the one trusting in Jehovah, loving - kindness itself surrounds him.
32.11: Rejoice in Jehovah and be joyful, YOU righteous ones; And cry out joyfully, all YOU who are upright in heart.

33.1: Cry out joyfully, O YOU righteous ones, because of Jehovah. On the part of the upright ones praise is fitting.
33.2: Give thanks to Jehovah on the harp; On an instrument of ten strings make melody to him.
33.3: Sing to him a new song; Do YOUR best at playing on the strings along with joyful shouting.
33.4: For the word of Jehovah is upright, And all his work is in faithfulness.
33.5: He is a lover of righteousness and justice. With the loving - kindness of Jehovah the earth is filled.
33.6: By the word of Jehovah the heavens themselves were made, And by the spirit of his mouth all their army.
33.7: He is gathering as by a dam the waters of the sea, Putting in storehouses the surging waters.
33.8: Let all I [ those of] the earth be in fear of Jehovah. At him let all the inhabitants of the productive land be frightened.
33.9: For he himself said, and it came to be; He himself commanded, and it proceeded to stand so.
33.10: Jehovah himself has broken up the counsel of the nations; He has thwarted the thoughts of the peoples.
33.11: To time indefinite the very counsel of Jehovah will stand; The thoughts of his heart are to one generation after another generation.
33.12: Happy is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he has chosen as his inheritance.
33.13: From the heavens Jehovah has looked, He has seen all the sons of men.
33.14: From the established place where he dwells He has gazed at all those dwelling on the earth.
33.15: He is forming their hearts all together; He is considering all their works.
33.16: There is no king saved by the abundance of military forces; A mighty man himself is not delivered by the abundance of power.
33.17: The horse is a deception for salvation, And by the abundance of its vital energy it does not afford escape.
33.18: Look! The eye of Jehovah is toward those fearing him, To those waiting for his loving - kindness,
33.19: To deliver their soul from death itself, And to preserve them alive in famine.
33.20: Our very soul has been in expectation of Jehovah. Our helper and our shield he is.
33.21: For in him our heart rejoices; For in his holy name we have put our trust.
33.22: Let your loving - kindness, O Jehovah, prove to be upon us, Even as we have kept waiting for you.

34.1: I will bless Jehovah at all times; Constantly his praise will be in my mouth.
34.2: In Jehovah my soul will make its boast; The meek ones will hear and will rejoice.
34.3: O magnify Jehovah with me, YOU people, And let us exalt his name together.
34.4: I inquired of Jehovah, and he answered me, And out of all my frights he delivered me.
34.5: They looked to him and became radiant, And their very faces could not possibly be ashamed.
34.6: This afflicted one called, and Jehovah himself heard. And out of all his distresses He saved him.
34.7: The angel of Jehovah is camping all around those fearing him, And he rescues them.
34.8: Taste and see that Jehovah is good, O YOU people; Happy is the able - bodied man that takes refuge in him.
34.9: Fear Jehovah, YOU holy ones of his, For there is no lack to those fearing him.
34.10: The maned young lions themselves have had little on hand and gone hungry; But as for those seeking Jehovah, they will not lack anything good.
34.11: Come, YOU sons, listen to me; The fear of Jehovah is what I shall teach YOU.
34.12: Who is the man that is delighting in life, That is loving enough days to see what is good?
34.13: Safeguard your tongue against what is bad, And your lips against speaking deception.
34.14: Turn away from what is bad, and do what is good; Seek to find peace, and pursue it.
34.15: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous ones, And his ears are toward their cry for help.
34.16: The face of Jehovah is against those doing what is bad, To cut off the mention of them from the very earth.
34.17: They cried out, and Jehovah himself heard, And out of all their distresses he delivered them.
34.18: Jehovah is near to those that are broken at heart; And those who are crushed in spirit he saves.
34.19: Many are the calamities of the righteous one, But out of them all Jehovah delivers him.
34.20: He is guarding all the bones of that one; Not one of them has been broken.
34.21: Calamity will put the wicked one himself to death; And the very ones hating the righteous one will be held guilty.
34.22: Jehovah is redeeming the soul of his servants; And none of those taking refuge in him will be held guilty.

35.1: Do conduct my case, O Jehovah, against my opponents; War against those warring against me.
35.2: Take hold of buckler and large shield, And do rise up in assistance of me,
35.3: And draw spear and double ax to meet those pursuing me. Say to my soul: " I am your salvation. "
35.4: May those be shamed and humiliated who are hunting for my soul. May those be turned back and be abashed who are scheming calamity for me.
35.5: May they become like chaff before the wind, And let Jehovah's angel be pushing I [ them] along.
35.6: Let their way become darkness and slippery places, And let Jehovah's angel be pursuing them.
35.7: For without cause they have hid for me their netted pit; Without cause they have dug it for my soul.
35.8: Let ruin come upon him without his knowing, And let his own net that he hid catch him; With ruin let him fall into it.
35.9: But let my own soul be joyful in Jehovah; Let it exult in his salvation.
35.10: Let all my bones themselves say: " O Jehovah, who is there like you, Delivering the afflicted one from one stronger than he is, And the afflicted and poor one from the one robbing him? "
35.11: Violent witnesses rise up; What I have not known they ask me.
35.12: They reward me with bad for good, Bereavement to my soul.
35.13: As for me, when they became ill, my clothing was sackcloth, With fasting I afflicted my soul, And upon my bosom my own prayer would return.
35.14: As for a companion, as for a brother of mine, I walked about like one mourning for a mother. Saddened, I bowed down.
35.15: But at my limping they rejoiced and gathered together; They gathered together against me, Striking I [ me] down when I did not know it; They ripped I [ me] to pieces and did not keep silent.
35.16: Among the apostate mockers for a cake There was a grinding of their teeth even against me.
35.17: O Jehovah, how long will you keep seeing I [ it]? Do bring back my soul from their ravages, Even my only one from the maned young lions.
35.18: I will laud you in the big congregation; Among a numerous people I shall praise you.
35.19: O may those who for no reason are my enemies not rejoice over me; As for those hating me without cause, let them not wink the eye.
35.20: For it is not peace that they speak; But against the quiet ones of the earth Things of deception they keep scheming.
35.21: And they open wide their mouth even against me. They have said: " Aha! Aha! our eye has seen I [ it]. "
35.22: You have seen, O Jehovah. Do not keep silent. O Jehovah, do not keep yourself far from me.
35.23: Do arouse yourself and awake to my judgment, O my God, even Jehovah, to my case at law.
35.24: Judge me according to your righteousness, O Jehovah my God, And may they not rejoice over me.
35.25: O may they not say in their heart: " Aha, our soul! " May they not say: " We have swallowed him up. "
35.26: Let those be ashamed and abashed all together Who are joyful at my calamity. Let those be clothed with shame and humiliation who are assuming great airs against me.
35.27: Let those cry out joyfully and rejoice who are delighting in my righteousness, And let them say constantly: " Let Jehovah be magnified, who takes delight in the peace of his servant. "
35.28: And let my own tongue utter in an undertone your righteousness, All day long your praise.

36.1: The utterance of transgression to the wicked one is in the midst of his heart; There is no dread of God in front of his eyes.
36.2: For he has acted too smoothly to himself in his own eyes To find out his error so as to hate I [ it].
36.3: The words of his mouth are hurtfulness and deception; He has ceased to have insight for doing good.
36.4: Hurtfulness is what he keeps scheming upon his bed. He stations himself on a way that is not good. What is bad he does not reject.
36.5: O Jehovah, your loving - kindness is in the heavens; Your faithfulness is up to the clouds.
36.6: Your righteousness is like mountains of God; Your judicial decision is a vast watery deep. Man and beast you save, O Jehovah.
36.7: How precious your loving - kindness is, O God! And in the shadow of your wings the sons of men themselves take refuge.
36.8: They drink their fill of the fatness of your house; And of the torrent of your pleasures you cause them to drink.
36.9: For with you is the source of life; By light from you we can see light.
36.10: Continue your loving - kindness to those knowing you, And your righteousness to those upright in heart.
36.11: O may not the foot of haughtiness come I [ against] me; As for the hand of wicked people, let it not make me a wanderer.
36.12: There the practicers of hurtfulness have fallen; They have been pushed down and have been unable to get up.

37.1: Do not show yourself heated up because of the evildoers. Do not be envious of those doing unrighteousness.
37.2: For like grass they will speedily wither, And like green new grass they will fade away.
37.3: Trust in Jehovah and do good; Reside in the earth, and deal with faithfulness.
37.4: Also take exquisite delight in Jehovah, And he will give you the requests of your heart.
37.5: Roll upon Jehovah your way, And rely upon him, and he himself will act.
37.6: And he will certainly bring forth your righteousness as the light itself, And your justice as the midday.
37.7: Keep silent before Jehovah And wait longingly for him. Do not show yourself heated up at anyone making his way successful, At the man carrying out I [ his] ideas.
37.8: Let anger alone and leave rage; Do not show yourself heated up only to do evil.
37.9: For evildoers themselves will be cut off, But those hoping in Jehovah are the ones that will possess the earth.
37.10: And just a little while longer, and the wicked one will be no more; And you will certainly give attention to his place, and he will not be.
37.11: But the meek ones themselves will possess the earth, And they will indeed find their exquisite delight in the abundance of peace.
37.12: The wicked one is plotting against the righteous one, And at him he is grinding his teeth.
37.13: Jehovah himself will laugh at him, For he certainly sees that his day will come.
37.14: The wicked ones have drawn a sword itself and have bent their bow, To cause the afflicted and poor one to fall, To slaughter those who are upright in I [ their] way.
37.15: Their own sword will enter into their heart, And their own bows will be broken.
37.16: Better is the little of the righteous one Than the abundance of the many wicked ones.
37.17: For the very arms of the wicked ones will be broken, But Jehovah will be supporting the righteous ones.
37.18: Jehovah is aware of the days of the faultless ones, And their very inheritance will continue even to time indefinite.
37.19: They will not be ashamed in the time of calamity, And in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
37.20: For the wicked themselves will perish, And the enemies of Jehovah will be like the preciousness of pastures; They must come to their end. In smoke they must come to their end.
37.21: The wicked one is borrowing and does not pay back, But the righteous one is showing favor and is making gifts.
37.22: For those being blessed by him will themselves possess the earth, But those upon whom evil is called by him will be cut off.
37.23: By Jehovah the very steps of an able - bodied man have been made ready, And in his way He takes delight.
37.24: Although he may fall, he will not be hurled down, For Jehovah is supporting his hand.
37.25: A young man I used to be, I have also grown old, And yet I have not seen anyone righteous left entirely, Nor his offspring looking for bread.
37.26: All day long he is showing favor and lending, And so his offspring are in line for a blessing.
37.27: Turn away from what is bad and do what is good, And so reside to time indefinite.
37.28: For Jehovah is a lover of justice, And he will not leave his loyal ones. To time indefinite they will certainly be guarded; But as for the offspring of the wicked ones, they will indeed be cut off.
37.29: The righteous themselves will possess the earth, And they will reside forever upon it.
37.30: The mouth of the righteous is the one that utters wisdom in an undertone, And his is the tongue that speaks justly.
37.31: The law of his God is in his heart; His steps will not wobble.
37.32: The wicked one is keeping on the watch for the righteous And is seeking to put him to death.
37.33: As for Jehovah, he will not leave him to the hand of that one, And he will not pronounce him wicked when he is being judged.
37.34: Hope in Jehovah and keep his way, And he will exalt you to take possession of the earth. When the wicked ones are cut off, you will see I [ it].
37.35: I have seen the wicked a tyrant And spreading himself as a luxuriant I [ tree] in native soil.
37.36: And yet he proceeded to pass away, and there he was not; And I kept seeking him, and he was not found.
37.37: Watch the blameless one and keep the upright one in sight, For the future of I [ that] man will be peaceful.
37.38: But the transgressors themselves will certainly be annihilated together; The future of wicked people will indeed be cut off.
37.39: And the salvation of the righteous ones is from Jehovah; He is their fortress in the time of distress.
37.40: And Jehovah will help them and provide them with escape. He will provide them with escape from wicked people and save them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

38.1: O Jehovah, do not in your indignation reprove me, Nor in your rage correct me.
38.2: For your own arrows have sunk themselves deep into me, And upon me your hand is come down.
38.3: There is no sound spot in my flesh because of your denunciation. There is no peace in my bones on account of my sin.
38.4: For my own errors have passed over my head; Like a heavy load they are too heavy for me.
38.5: My wounds have become stinky, they have festered, Because of my foolishness.
38.6: I have become disconcerted, I have bowed low to an extreme degree; All day long I have walked about sad.
38.7: For my very loins have become full of burning, And there is no sound spot in my flesh.
38.8: I have grown numb and become crushed to an extreme degree; I have roared due to the groaning of my heart.
38.9: O Jehovah, in front of you is all my desire, And from you my sighing itself has not been concealed.
38.10: My own heart has palpitated heavily, my power has left me, And the light of my own eyes also is not with me.
38.11: As for my lovers and my companions, they keep standing away from my plague, And my close acquaintances themselves have stood off at a distance.
38.12: But those seeking my soul lay out traps, And those working for a calamity to me have spoken of adversities, And deceptions they keep muttering all day long.
38.13: As for me, like someone deaf, I would not listen; And like someone speechless, I would not open my mouth.
38.14: And I came to be like a man that was not hearing, And in my mouth there were no counterarguments.
38.15: For on you, O Jehovah, I waited; You yourself proceeded to answer, O Jehovah my God.
38.16: For I said: " Otherwise they would rejoice at me; When my foot moved unsteadily, they would certainly assume great airs against me. "
38.17: For I was ready to limp, And my pain was in front of me constantly.
38.18: For I proceeded to tell about my own error; I began to be anxious over my sin.
38.19: And my enemies who are alive became mighty, And those hating me for no reason became many.
38.20: And they were rewarding me with bad for good; They kept resisting me in return for my pursuing what is good.
38.21: Do not leave me, O Jehovah. O my God, do not keep far away from me.
38.22: Do make haste to my assistance, O Jehovah my salvation.

39.1: I said: " I will guard my ways To keep from sinning with my tongue. I will set a muzzle as a guard to my own mouth, As long as anyone wicked is in front of me. "
39.2: I became speechless with silence; I kept quiet from what is good, And my being pained was ostracized.
39.3: My heart grew hot inside me; During my sighing the fire kept burning. I spoke with my tongue:
39.4: " Cause me, O Jehovah, to know my end, And the measure of my days - what it is, That I may know how transient I am.
39.5: Look! You have made my days just a few; And my life's duration is as nothing in front of you. Surely every earthling man, though standing firm, is nothing but an exhalation. Se'lah.
39.6: Surely in a semblance man walks about. Surely they are boisterous in vain. One piles up things and does not know who will be gathering them.
39.7: And now for what have I hoped, O Jehovah? My expectation is toward you.
39.8: From all my transgressions deliver me. Do not set me as a reproach of the senseless one.
39.9: I kept speechless; I could not open my mouth, For you yourself acted.
39.10: Remove from off me your plague. Due to the hostility of your hand I myself have come to an end.
39.11: By reproofs against error you have corrected man, And you consume his desirable things just as a moth does. Surely every earthling man is an exhalation. Se'lah.
39.12: Do hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And to my cry for help do give ear. At my tears do not keep silent. For I am but an alien resident with you, A settler the same as all my forefathers.
39.13: Look away from me, that I may brighten up Before I go away and I am not. "

40.1: I earnestly hoped in Jehovah, And so he inclined I [ his ear] to me and heard my cry for help.
40.2: He also proceeded to bring me up out of a roaring pit, Out of the mire of I [ the] sediment. Then he raised up my feet upon a crag; He firmly established my steps.
40.3: Further, he put in my mouth a new song, Praise to our God. Many will see I [ it] and will fear, And they will trust in Jehovah.
40.4: Happy is the able - bodied man that has put Jehovah as his trust And that has not turned his face to defiant people, Nor to those falling away to lies.
40.5: Many things you yourself have done, O Jehovah my God, even your wonderful works and your thoughts toward us; There is none to be compared to you. Were I inclined to tell and speak I [ of them], They have become more numerous than I can recount.
40.6: Sacrifice and offering you did not delight in; These ears of mine you opened up. Burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask for.
40.7: In view of that, I said: " Here I have come, In the roll of the book it being written about me.
40.8: To do your will, O my God, I have delighted, And your law is within my inward parts.
40.9: I have told the good news of righteousness in the big congregation. Look! My lips I do not restrain. O Jehovah, you yourself know that well.
40.10: Your righteousness I have not covered over within my heart. Your faithfulness and your salvation I have declared. I have not hidden your loving - kindness and your trueness in the big congregation. "
40.11: You yourself, O Jehovah, do not restrain your pity from me. Let your loving - kindness and your trueness themselves constantly safeguard me.
40.12: For calamities encircled me until there was no numbering of them. More errors of mine overtook me than I was able to see; They became more numerous than the hairs of my head, And my own heart left me.
40.13: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me. O Jehovah, to my assistance do make haste.
40.14: May those be ashamed and abashed all together Who are seeking my soul to sweep it away. May those turn back and be humiliated who are delighting in my calamity.
40.15: Let those stare in amazement in consequence of their shame Who are saying to me: " Aha! Aha! "
40.16: Let those exult and rejoice in you, All those who are seeking you. Let those say constantly: " May Jehovah be magnified, " Those who are loving salvation by you.
40.17: But I am afflicted and poor. Jehovah himself takes account of me. You are my assistance and the Provider of escape for me. O my God, do not be too late.

41.1: Happy is anyone acting with consideration toward the lowly one; In the day of calamity Jehovah will provide escape for him.
41.2: Jehovah himself will guard him and preserve him alive. He will be pronounced happy in the earth; And you cannot possibly give him over to the soul of his enemies.
41.3: Jehovah himself will sustain him upon a divan of illness; All his bed you will certainly change during his sickness.
41.4: As for me, I said: " O Jehovah, show me favor. Do heal my soul, for I have sinned against you. "
41.5: As for my enemies, they say what is bad concerning me: " When will he die and his name actually perish? "
41.6: And if one does come to see I [ me], untruth is what his heart will speak; He will gather up for himself something hurtful; He will go out; on the outside he will speak I [ of it].
41.7: Unitedly against me all those hating me whisper to one another; Against me they keep scheming something bad for me:
41.8: " A good - for - nothing thing is poured out upon him; Now that he has lain down, he will not get up again. "
41.9: Also the man at peace with me, in whom I trusted, Who was eating my bread, has magnified I [ his] heel against me.
41.10: As for you, O Jehovah, show me favor and cause me to get up, That I may pay them back.
41.11: By this I do know that you have found delight in me, Because my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.
41.12: As for me, because of my integrity you have upheld me, And you will set me before your face to time indefinite.
41.13: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel From time indefinite even to time indefinite. Amen and Amen.

42.1: As the hind that longs for the water streams, So my very soul longs for you, O God.
42.2: My soul indeed thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear I [ before] God?
42.3: To me my tears have become food day and night, While I [ they] say to me all day long: " Where is your God? "
42.4: These things I will remember, and I will pour out my soul within me. For I used to pass along with the throng, I used to walk slowly before them to the house of God, With the voice of a joyful cry and thanksgiving, Of a crowd celebrating a festival.
42.5: Why are you in despair, O my soul, And why are you boisterous within me? Wait for God, For I shall yet laud him as the grand salvation of my person.
42.6: O my God, within me my very soul is in despair. That is why I remember you, From the land of Jordan and the peaks of Her'mon, From the little mountain.
42.7: Watery deep to watery deep is calling At the sound of your ( water - ) spouts. All your breakers and your waves - Over me they have passed.
42.8: By day Jehovah will command his loving - kindness, And by night his song will be with me; There will be prayer to the God of my life.
42.9: I will say to God my crag: " Why have you forgotten me? Why do I walk sad because of the oppression of the enemy? "
42.10: With murder against my bones those showing hostility to me have reproached me, While they say to me all day long: " Where is your God? "
42.11: Why are you in despair, O my soul, And why are you boisterous within me? Wait for God, For I shall yet laud him as the grand salvation of my person and as my God.

43.1: Judge me, O God, And do conduct my legal case against a nation not loyal. From the man of deception and unrighteousness may you provide me with escape.
43.2: For you are the God of my fortress. Why have you cast me off? Why do I walk about sad because of the oppression by the enemy?
43.3: Send out your light and your truth. May these themselves lead me. May they bring me to your holy mountain and to your grand tabernacle.
43.4: And I will come to the altar of God, To God, my exultant rejoicing. And I will laud you on the harp, O God, my God.
43.5: Why are you in despair, O my soul, And why are you boisterous within me? Wait for God, For I shall yet laud him as the grand salvation of my person and as my God.

44.1: O God, with our ears we have heard, Our forefathers themselves have recounted to us The activity that you performed in their days, In the days of long ago.
44.2: You yourself by your hand drove away even nations, And you proceeded to plant them I [ instead]. You went breaking national groups and sending them away.
44.3: For it was not by their own sword that they took possession of the land, And their own arm was not what brought them salvation. For it was your right hand and your arm and the light of your face, Because you took pleasure in them.
44.4: You yourself are my King, O God. Command grand salvation for Jacob.
44.5: By you we shall push our adversaries themselves; In your name we shall tread down those rising up against us.
44.6: For it was not in my bow that I kept trusting And it was not my sword that was saving me.
44.7: For you saved us from our adversaries, And those intensely hating us you put to shame.
44.8: In God we will offer praise all day long, And to time indefinite your name we shall laud. Se'lah.
44.9: But now you have cast off and keep humiliating us, And you do not go forth with our armies.
44.10: You keep making us turn back from the adversary, And the very ones intensely hating us have pillaged for themselves.
44.11: You give us up like sheep, as something to eat, And among the nations you have scattered us.
44.12: You sell your people for no value at all, And you have made no wealth by the price for them.
44.13: You set us as a reproach to our neighbors, A derision and jeering to those all around us.
44.14: You set us as a proverbial saying among the nations, A shaking of the head among the national groups.
44.15: All day long my humiliation is in front of me, And the shame of my own face has covered me,
44.16: Due to the voice of the one reproaching and speaking abusively, Because of the enemy and the one taking his revenge.
44.17: All this is what has come upon us, and we have not forgotten you, And we have not acted falsely in your covenant.
44.18: Our heart has not turned faithlessly back, Nor do our footsteps deviate from your path.
44.19: For you have crushed us in the place of jackals, And you cover us over with deep shadow.
44.20: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or we spread out our palms to a strange god,
44.21: Will not God himself search this out? For he is aware of the secrets of the heart.
44.22: But for your sake we have been killed all day long; We have been accounted as sheep for slaughtering.
44.23: Do arouse yourself. Why do you keep sleeping, O Jehovah? Do awake. Do not keep casting off forever.
44.24: Why do you keep your very face concealed? Why do you forget our affliction and our oppression?
44.25: For our soul has bowed down to the dust itself; Our belly has clung to the very earth.
44.26: Do arise in assistance to us And redeem us for the sake of your loving - kindness.

45.1: My heart has become astir with a goodly matter. I am saying: " My works are concerning a king. " May my tongue be the stylus of a skilled copyist.
45.2: You are indeed more handsome than the sons of men. Charm has been poured out upon your lips. That is why God has blessed you to time indefinite.
45.3: Gird your sword upon I [ your] thigh, O mighty one, I [ With] your dignity and your splendor.
45.4: And in your splendor go on to success; Ride in the cause of truth and humility I [ and] righteousness, And your right hand will instruct you in fear - inspiring things.
45.5: Your arrows are sharp - under you peoples keep falling - In the heart of the enemies of the king.
45.6: God is your throne to time indefinite, even forever; The scepter of your kingship is a scepter of uprightness.
45.7: You have loved righteousness and you hate wickedness. That is why God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of exultation more than your partners.
45.8: All your garments are myrrh and aloeswood I [ and] cassia; Out from the grand ivory palace stringed instruments themselves have made you rejoice.
45.9: The daughters of kings are among your precious women. The queenly consort has taken her stand at your right hand in gold of O'phir.
45.10: Listen, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear; And forget your people and your father's house.
45.11: And the king will long for your prettiness, For he is your lord, So bow down to him.
45.12: The daughter of Tyre also with a gift - The rich ones of the people will soften your own face.
45.13: The king's daughter is all glorious within I [ the house]; Her clothing is with settings of gold.
45.14: In woven apparel she will be brought to the king. The virgins in her train as her companions are being brought in to you.
45.15: They will be brought with rejoicing and joyfulness; They will enter into the palace of the king.
45.16: In place of your forefathers there will come to be your sons, Whom you will appoint as princes in all the earth.
45.17: I will make mention of your name throughout all generations to come. That is why peoples themselves will laud you to time indefinite, even forever.

46.1: God is for us a refuge and strength, A help that is readily to be found during distresses.
46.2: That is why we shall not fear, though the earth undergo change And though the mountains totter into the heart of the vast sea;
46.3: Though its waters be boisterous, foam over, Though the mountains rock at its uproar. Se'lah.
46.4: There is a river the streams of which make the city of God rejoice, The holiest grand tabernacle of the Most High.
46.5: God is in the midst of I [ the city]; it will not be made to totter. God will help it at the appearance of morning.
46.6: The nations became boisterous, the kingdoms tottered; He sounded with his voice, the earth proceeded to melt.
46.7: Jehovah of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is a secure height for us. Se'lah.
46.8: Come, YOU people, behold the activities of Jehovah, How he has set astonishing events on the earth.
46.9: He is making wars to cease to the extremity of the earth. The bow he breaks apart and does cut the spear in pieces; The wagons he burns in the fire.
46.10: " Give in, YOU people, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth. "
46.11: Jehovah of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is a secure height for us. Se'lah.

47.1: All YOU peoples, clap YOUR hands. Shout in triumph to God with the sound of a joyful cry.
47.2: For Jehovah, the Most High, is fear - inspiring, A great King over all the earth.
47.3: He will subdue peoples under us And national groups under our feet.
47.4: He will choose for us our inheritance, The pride of Jacob, whom he has loved. Se'lah.
47.5: God has ascended with joyful shouting, Jehovah with the sound of the horn.
47.6: MAKE melody to God, make melody. Make melody to our King, make melody.
47.7: For God is King of all the earth; MAKE melody, acting with discretion.
47.8: God has become king over the nations. God himself has taken his seat upon his holy throne.
47.9: The nobles of the peoples themselves have gathered together, I [ With] the people of the God of Abraham. For to God the shields of the earth belong. He is very high in his ascent.

48.1: Jehovah is great and much to be praised In the city of our God, I [ in] his holy mountain.
48.2: Pretty for loftiness, the exultation of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion on the remote sides of the north, The town of the grand King.
48.3: In her dwelling towers God himself has become known as a secure height.
48.4: For, look! the kings themselves have met by appointment, They have passed by together.
48.5: They themselves saw; I [ and] so they were amazed. They got disturbed, they were sent running in panic.
48.6: Trembling itself took hold of them there, Birth pangs like those of a woman giving birth.
48.7: With an east wind you wreck the ships of Tar'shish.
48.8: Just as we have heard, so we have seen In the city of Jehovah of armies, in the city of our God. God himself will firmly establish it to time indefinite. Se'lah.
48.9: We have pondered, O God, over your loving - kindness In the midst of your temple.
48.10: Like your name, O God, so your praise is To the borders of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness itself.
48.11: May Mount Zion rejoice, May the dependent towns of Judah be joyful, on account of your judicial decisions.
48.12: March around Zion, YOU people, and go about it, Count its towers.
48.13: Set YOUR hearts upon its rampart. Inspect its dwelling towers, In order that YOU may recount it to the future generation.
48.14: For this God is our God to time indefinite, even forever. He himself will guide us until I [ we] die.

49.1: Hear this, all YOU peoples. Give ear, all YOU inhabitants of the system of things,
49.2: YOU sons of humankind as well as YOU sons of man, You rich one and you poor one together.
49.3: My own mouth will speak things of wisdom, And the meditation of my heart will be of things of understanding.
49.4: To a proverbial utterance I shall incline my ear; On a harp I shall open up my riddle.
49.5: Why should I be afraid in the days of evil, I [ When] the very error of my supplanters surrounds me?
49.6: Those who are trusting in their means of maintenance, And who keep boasting about the abundance of their riches,
49.7: Not one of them can by any means redeem even a brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him;
49.8: ( And the redemption price of their soul is so precious That it has ceased to time indefinite )
49.9: That he should still live forever I [ and] not see the pit.
49.10: For he sees that even the wise ones die, Together the stupid one and the unreasoning one perish, And they must leave to others their means of maintenance.
49.11: Their inward wish is that their houses may be to time indefinite, Their tabernacles to generation after generation. They have called their landed estates by their names.
49.12: And yet earthling man, though in honor, cannot keep lodging; He is indeed comparable with the beasts that have been destroyed.
49.13: This is the way of those who have stupidity, And of those coming after them who take pleasure in their very mouthings. Se'lah.
49.14: Like sheep they have been appointed to She'ol itself; Death itself will shepherd them; And the upright ones will have them in subjection in the morning, And their forms are due to wear away; She'ol rather than a lofty abode is for each one.
49.15: However, God himself will redeem my soul from the hand of She'ol, For he will receive me. Se'lah.
49.16: Do not be afraid because some man gains riches, Because the glory of his house increases,
49.17: For at his death he cannot take along anything at all; His glory will not go down along with him himself.
49.18: For during his lifetime he kept blessing his own soul; ( And people will laud you because you do well for yourself )
49.19: I [ His soul] finally comes only as far as the generation of his forefathers. Nevermore will they see the light.
49.20: Earthling man, although in honor, who does not understand, Is indeed comparable with the beasts that have been destroyed.

50.1: The Divine One, God, Jehovah, has himself spoken, And he proceeds to call the earth, From the rising of the sun until its setting.
50.2: Out of Zion, the perfection of prettiness, God himself has beamed forth.
50.3: Our God will come and cannot possibly keep silent. Before him there devours a fire, And all around him it has become exceedingly stormy weather.
50.4: He calls to the heavens above and to the earth So as to execute judgment on his people:
50.5: " Gather to me my loyal ones, Those concluding my covenant over sacrifice. "
50.6: And the heavens tell of his righteousness, For God himself is Judge. Se'lah.
50.7: " Do listen, O my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will bear witness against you. I am God, your God.
50.8: Not concerning your sacrifices do I reprove you, Nor I [ concerning] your whole burnt offerings I [ that are] in front of me constantly.
50.9: I will not take out of your house a bull, Out of your pens he - goats.
50.10: For to me belongs every wild animal of the forest, The beasts upon a thousand mountains.
50.11: I well know every winged creature of the mountains, And the animal throngs of the open field are with me.
50.12: If I were hungry, I would not say it to you; For to me the productive land and its fullness belong.
50.13: Shall I eat the flesh of powerful I [ bulls], And the blood of he - goats shall I drink?
50.14: Offer thanksgiving as your sacrifice to God, And pay to the Most High your vows;
50.15: And call me in the day of distress. I shall rescue you, and you will glorify me. "
50.16: But to the wicked one God will have to say: " What right do you have to enumerate my regulations, And that you may bear my covenant in your mouth?
50.17: Why, you - you have hated discipline, And you keep throwing my words behind you.
50.18: Whenever you saw a thief, you were even pleased with him; And your sharing was with adulterers.
50.19: Your mouth you have let loose to what is bad, And your tongue you keep attached to deception.
50.20: You sit I [ and] speak against your own brother, Against the son of your mother you give away a fault.
50.21: These things you have done, and I kept silent. You imagined that I would positively become like you. I am going to reprove you, and I will set things in order before your eyes.
50.22: Understand this, please, YOU forgetters of God, That I may not tear I [ YOU] to pieces without there being any deliverer.
50.23: The one offering thanksgiving as his sacrifice is the one that glorifies me; And as for the one keeping a set way, I will cause him to see salvation by God. "

51.1: Show me favor, O God, according to your loving - kindness. According to the abundance of your mercies wipe out my transgressions.
51.2: Thoroughly wash me from my error, And cleanse me even from my sin.
51.3: For my transgressions I myself know, And my sin is in front of me constantly.
51.4: Against you, you alone, I have sinned, And what is bad in your eyes I have done, In order that you may prove to be righteous when you speak, That you may be in the clear when you judge.
51.5: Look! With error I was brought forth with birth pains, And in sin my mother conceived me.
51.6: Look! You have taken delight in truthfulness itself in the inward parts; And in the secret self may you cause me to know sheer wisdom.
51.7: May you purify me from sin with hyssop, that I may be clean; May you wash me, that I may become whiter even than snow.
51.8: May you cause me to hear exultation and rejoicing, That the bones that you have crushed may be joyful.
51.9: Conceal your face from my sins, And wipe out even all my errors.
51.10: Create in me even a pure heart, O God, And put within me a new spirit, a steadfast one.
51.11: Do not throw me away from before your face; And your holy spirit O do not take away from me.
51.12: Do restore to me the exultation of salvation by you, And may you support me even with a willing spirit.
51.13: I will teach transgressors your ways, That sinners themselves may turn right back to you.
51.14: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God the God of my salvation, That my tongue may joyfully tell about your righteousness.
51.15: O Jehovah, may you open these lips of mine, That my own mouth may tell forth your praise.
51.16: For you do not take delight in sacrifice - otherwise I would give I [ it]; In whole burnt offering you do not find pleasure.
51.17: The sacrifices to God are a broken spirit; A heart broken and crushed, O God, you will not despise.
51.18: In your goodwill do deal well with Zion; May you build the walls of Jerusalem.
51.19: In that case you will be delighted with sacrifices of righteousness, With burnt sacrifice and whole offering; In that case bulls will be offered up on your very own altar.

52.1: Why do you make your boast over what is bad, O you mighty one? The loving - kindness of God is all day long.
52.2: Adversities your tongue schemes up, sharpened like a razor, Working deceitfully.
52.3: You have loved what is bad more than what is good, Falsehood more than speaking righteousness. Se'lah.
52.4: You have loved all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.
52.5: God himself will also pull you down forever; He will knock you down and tear you away from I [ your] tent, And he will certainly root you out of the land of the living ones. Se'lah.
52.6: And the righteous ones will see I [ it] and will be afraid, And over him they will laugh.
52.7: Here is the able - bodied man that does not put God as his fortress, But that trusts in the abundance of his riches, That takes shelter in adversities by him.
52.8: But I shall be like a luxuriant olive tree in God's house; I do trust in the loving - kindness of God to time indefinite, even forever.
52.9: I will laud you to time indefinite, for you have taken action; And I shall hope in your name, because it is good, in front of your loyal ones.

53.1: The senseless one has said in his heart: " There is no Jehovah. " They have acted ruinously and have acted detestably in unrighteousness; There is no one doing good.
53.2: As for God, he has looked down from heaven itself upon the sons of men, To see whether there exists anyone having insight, anyone seeking Jehovah.
53.3: They have all of them turned back, they are I [ all] alike corrupt; There is no one doing good, Not even one.
53.4: Have none of the practicers of what is hurtful got knowledge, Eating up my people as they have eaten bread? They have not called even upon Jehovah.
53.5: There they were filled with a great dread, Where there had proved to be no dread; For God himself will certainly scatter the bones of anyone camping against you. You will certainly put I [ them] to shame, for Jehovah himself has rejected them.
53.6: O that out of Zion there were the grand salvation of Israel! When Jehovah gathers back the captive ones of his people, Let Jacob be joyful, let Israel rejoice.

54.1: O God, by your name save me, And with your mightiness may you plead my cause.
54.2: O God, hear my prayer; Do give ear to the sayings of my mouth.
54.3: For there are strangers that have risen up against me, And tyrants that do seek my soul. They have not set God in front of them. Se'lah.
54.4: Look! God is my helper; Jehovah is among those supporting my soul.
54.5: He will repay the bad to my foes; In your trueness silence them.
54.6: In willingness I will sacrifice to you. I shall laud your name, O Jehovah, for it is good.
54.7: For out of every distress he delivered me, And upon my enemies my eye has looked.

55.1: Do give ear, O God, to my prayer; And do not hide yourself from my request for favor.
55.2: Do pay attention to me and answer me. I am driven restlessly about by my concern, And I cannot but show disquietude,
55.3: Due to the voice of the enemy, because of the pressure of the wicked one. For they keep dropping upon me what is hurtful, And in anger they harbor animosity against me.
55.4: My very heart is in severe pain within me, And the frights of death itself have fallen upon me.
55.5: Fear, yes, trembling itself enters into me, And shuddering covers me.
55.6: And I keep saying: " O that I had wings as a dove has! I would fly away and reside.
55.7: Look! I would go far away in flight; I would lodge in the wilderness. - Se'lah -
55.8: I would hasten to a place of escape for me From the rushing wind, from the tempest. "
55.9: Confuse, O Jehovah, divide their tongue, For I have seen violence and disputing in the city.
55.10: Day and night they go round about it upon its walls; And hurtfulness and trouble are within it.
55.11: Adversities are within it; And from its public square oppression and deception have not moved away.
