94.16: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will take his stand for me against the practicers of hurtfulness?
94.17: Unless Jehovah had been of assistance to me, In a little while my soul would have resided in silence.
94.18: When I said: " My foot will certainly move unsteadily, " Your own loving - kindness, O Jehovah, kept sustaining me.
94.19: When my disquieting thoughts became many inside of me, Your own consolations began to fondle my soul.
94.20: Will the throne causing adversities be allied with you While it is framing trouble by decree?
94.21: They make sharp attacks on the soul of the righteous one And pronounce wicked even the blood of the innocent one.
94.22: But Jehovah will become a secure height for me, And my God the rock of my refuge.
94.23: And he will turn back upon them their hurtfulness And will silence them with their own calamity. Jehovah our God will silence them.

95.1: O come let us cry out joyfully to Jehovah! Let us shout in triumph to our Rock of salvation.
95.2: Let us come before his person with thanksgiving; Let us with melodies shout in triumph to him.
95.3: For Jehovah is a great God And a great King over all I [ other] gods,
95.4: He in whose hand are the inmost depths of the earth And to whom the peaks of the mountains belong;
95.5: To whom the sea, which he himself made, belongs And whose own hands formed the dry land itself.
95.6: O come in, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker.
95.7: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasturage and the sheep of his hand. Today if YOU people listen to his own voice,
95.8: Do not harden YOUR heart as at Mer'i·bah, As in the day of Mas'sah in the wilderness,
95.9: When YOUR forefathers put me to the proof; They examined me, they also saw my activity.
95.10: For forty years I kept feeling a loathing toward I [ that] generation, And I proceeded to say: " They are a people wayward at heart, And they themselves have not come to know my ways ";
95.11: Concerning whom I swore in my anger: " They shall not enter into my resting - place. "

96.1: Sing to Jehovah a new song. Sing to Jehovah, all I [ YOU people of] the earth.
96.2: Sing to Jehovah, bless his name. From day to day tell the good news of salvation by him.
96.3: Declare among the nations his glory, Among all the peoples his wonderful works.
96.4: For Jehovah is great and very much to be praised. He is fear - inspiring above all I [ other] gods.
96.5: For all the gods of the peoples are valueless gods; But as for Jehovah, he has made the very heavens.
96.6: Dignity and splendor are before him; Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
96.7: Ascribe to Jehovah, O YOU families of the peoples, Ascribe to Jehovah glory and strength.
96.8: Ascribe to Jehovah the glory belonging to his name; Carry a gift and come into his courtyards.
96.9: Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment; Be in severe pains because of him, all I [ YOU people of] the earth.
96.10: Say among the nations: " Jehovah himself has become king. The productive land also becomes firmly established so that it cannot be made to totter. He will plead the cause of the peoples in uprightness. "
96.11: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be joyful. Let the sea thunder and that which fills it.
96.12: Let the open field exult and all that is in it. At the same time let all the trees of the forest break out joyfully
96.13: Before Jehovah. For he has come; For he has come to judge the earth. He will judge the productive land with righteousness And the peoples with his faithfulness.

97.1: Jehovah himself has become king! Let the earth be joyful. Let the many islands rejoice.
97.2: Clouds and thick gloom are all around him; Righteousness and judgment are the established place of his throne.
97.3: Before him a very fire goes, And it consumes his adversaries all around.
97.4: His lightnings lighted up the productive land; The earth saw and came to be in severe pains.
97.5: The mountains themselves proceeded to melt just like wax on account of Jehovah, On account of the Lord of the whole earth.
97.6: The heavens have told forth his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
97.7: Let all those serving any carved image be ashamed, Those who are making their boast in valueless gods. Bow down to him, all YOU gods.
97.8: Zion heard and began to rejoice, And the dependent towns of Judah began to be joyful By reason of your judicial decisions, O Jehovah.
97.9: For you, O Jehovah, are the Most High over all the earth; You are very high in your ascent over all I [ other] gods.
97.10: O YOU lovers of Jehovah, hate what is bad. He is guarding the souls of his loyal ones; Out of the hand of the wicked ones he delivers them.
97.11: Light itself has flashed up for the righteous one, And rejoicing even for the ones upright in heart.
97.12: Rejoice in Jehovah, O YOU righteous ones, And give thanks to his holy memorial.

98.1: SING to Jehovah a new song, For wonderful are the things that he has done. His right hand, even his holy arm, has gained salvation for him.
98.2: Jehovah has made his salvation known; In the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.
98.3: He has remembered his loving - kindness and his faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation by our God.
98.4: Shout in triumph to Jehovah, all I [ YOU people of] the earth. Be cheerful and cry out joyfully and make melody.
98.5: Make melody to Jehovah with the harp, With the harp and the voice of melody.
98.6: With the trumpets and the sound of the horn Shout in triumph before the King, Jehovah.
98.7: Let the sea thunder and that which fills it, The productive land and those dwelling in it.
98.8: Let the rivers themselves clap their hands; All together let the very mountains cry out joyfully
98.9: Before Jehovah, for he has come to judge the earth. He will judge the productive land with righteousness And the peoples with uprightness.

99.1: Jehovah himself has become king. Let the peoples be agitated. He is sitting upon the cherubs. Let the earth quiver.
99.2: Jehovah is great in Zion, And he is high over all the peoples.
99.3: Let them laud your name. Great and fear - inspiring, holy it is.
99.4: And with the strength of a king judgment he has loved. You yourself have firmly established uprightness. Judgment and righteousness in Jacob are what you yourself have effected.
99.5: Exalt Jehovah our God and bow down yourselves at his footstool; He is holy.
99.6: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, And Samuel was among those calling upon his name. They were calling to Jehovah, and he himself kept answering them.
99.7: In the pillar of cloud he continued speaking to them. They kept his reminders and the regulation that he gave to them.
99.8: O Jehovah our God, you yourself answered them. A God granting pardon you proved to be to them, And executing vengeance against their notorious deeds.
99.9: Exalt Jehovah our God And bow down yourselves at his holy mountain. For Jehovah our God is holy.

100.1: Shout in triumph to Jehovah, all I [ YOU people of] the earth.
100.2: Serve Jehovah with rejoicing. Come in before him with a joyful cry.
100.3: Know that Jehovah is God. It is he that has made us, and not we ourselves. I [ We are] his people and the sheep of his pasturage.
100.4: Come into his gates with thanksgiving, Into his courtyards with praise. Give thanks to him, bless his name.
100.5: For Jehovah is good; His loving - kindness is to time indefinite, And his faithfulness to generation after generation.

101.1: About loving - kindness and judgment I will sing. To you, O Jehovah, I will make melody.
101.2: I will act with discretion in a faultless way. When will you come to me? I shall walk about in the integrity of my heart inside my house.
101.3: I shall not set in front of my eyes any good - for - nothing thing. The doing of those who fall away I have hated; It does not cling to me.
101.4: A crooked heart departs from me; Nothing bad do I know.
101.5: Anyone slandering his companion in secrecy, Him I silence. Anyone of haughty eyes and of arrogant heart, Him I cannot endure.
101.6: My eyes are upon the faithful ones of the earth, That they may dwell with me. The one walking in a faultless way, He it is who will minister to me.
101.7: There will dwell inside my house no worker of trickiness. As for anyone speaking falsehoods, he will not be firmly established In front of my eyes.
101.8: Every morning I shall silence all the wicked ones of the earth, To cut off from the city of Jehovah all the practicers of what is hurtful.

102.1: O Jehovah, do hear my prayer; And to you may my own cry for help come.
102.2: Do not conceal your face from me on the day that I am in sore straits. Incline to me your ear; On the day that I call, hurry, answer me.
102.3: For my days have come to an end just like smoke, And my very bones have been made red - hot just like a fireplace.
102.4: My heart has been struck just like vegetation and is dried up, For I have forgotten to eat my food.
102.5: Because of the sound of my sighing My bones have stuck to my flesh.
102.6: I do resemble the pelican of the wilderness. I have become like a little owl of desolated places.
102.7: I have grown emaciated, And I am become like a bird isolated upon a roof.
102.8: All day long my enemies have reproached me. Those making a fool of me have sworn even by me.
102.9: For I have eaten ashes themselves just like bread; And the things I drink I have mingled even with weeping,
102.10: Because of your denunciation and your indignation; For you have lifted me up, that you might throw me away.
102.11: My days are like a shadow that has declined, And I myself am dried up like mere vegetation.
102.12: As for you, O Jehovah, to time indefinite you will dwell, And your memorial will be for generation after generation.
102.13: You yourself will arise, you will have mercy on Zion, For it is the season to be favorable to her, For the appointed time has come.
102.14: For your servants have found pleasure in her stones, And to her dust they direct their favor.
102.15: And the nations will fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth your glory.
102.16: For Jehovah will certainly build up Zion; He must appear in his glory.
102.17: He will certainly turn to the prayer of those stripped I [ of everything], And not despise their prayer.
102.18: This is written for the future generation; And the people that is to be created will praise Jah.
102.19: For he has looked down from his holy height, From the very heavens Jehovah himself has looked even at the earth,
102.20: To hear the sighing of the prisoner, To loosen those appointed to death;
102.21: For the name of Jehovah to be declared in Zion And his praise in Jerusalem,
102.22: When the peoples are collected all together, And the kingdoms to serve Jehovah.
102.23: On the way he afflicted my power, He cut short my days.
102.24: I proceeded to say: " O my God, Do not take me off at the half of my days; Your years are throughout all generations.
102.25: Long ago you laid the foundations of the earth itself, And the heavens are the work of your hands.
102.26: They themselves will perish, but you yourself will keep standing; And just like a garment they will all of them wear out. Just like clothing you will replace them, and they will finish their turn.
102.27: But you are the same, and your own years will not be completed.
102.28: The sons of your servants will continue residing; And before you their own offspring will be firmly established. "

103.1: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, Even everything within me, his holy name.
103.2: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And do not forget all his doings,
103.3: Him who is forgiving all your error, Who is healing all your maladies,
103.4: Who is reclaiming your life from the very pit, Who is crowning you with loving - kindness and mercies,
103.5: Who is satisfying your lifetime with what is good; Your youth keeps renewing itself just like that of an eagle.
103.6: Jehovah is executing acts of righteousness And judicial decisions for all those being defrauded.
103.7: He made known his ways to Moses, His dealings even to the sons of Israel.
103.8: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger and abundant in loving - kindness.
103.9: He will not for all time keep finding fault, Neither will he to time indefinite keep resentful.
103.10: He has not done to us even according to our sins; Nor according to our errors has he brought upon us what we deserve.
103.11: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, His loving - kindness is superior toward those fearing him.
103.12: As far off as the sunrise is from the sunset, So far off from us he has put our transgressions.
103.13: As a father shows mercy to his sons, Jehovah has shown mercy to those fearing him.
103.14: For he himself well knows the formation of us, Remembering that we are dust.
103.15: As for mortal man, his days are like those of green grass; Like a blossom of the field is the way he blossoms forth.
103.16: For a mere wind has to pass over it, and it is no more; And its place will acknowledge it no further.
103.17: But the loving - kindness of Jehovah is from time indefinite even to time indefinite Toward those fearing him, And his righteousness to the sons of sons,
103.18: Toward those keeping his covenant And toward those remembering his orders so as to carry them out.
103.19: Jehovah himself has firmly established his throne in the very heavens; And over everything his own kingship has held domination.
103.20: Bless Jehovah, O YOU angels of his, mighty in power, carrying out his word, By listening to the voice of his word.
103.21: Bless Jehovah, all YOU armies of his, You ministers of his, doing his will.
103.22: Bless Jehovah, all YOU his works, In all places of his domination. Bless Jehovah, O my soul.

104.1: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, you have proved very great. With dignity and splendor you have clothed yourself,
104.2: Enwrapping yourself with light as with a garment, Stretching out the heavens like a tent cloth,
104.3: The One building his upper chambers with beams in the very waters, Making the clouds his chariot, Walking upon the wings of the wind,
104.4: Making his angels spirits, His ministers a devouring fire.
104.5: He has founded the earth upon its established places; It will not be made to totter to time indefinite, or forever.
104.6: With a watery deep just like a garment you covered it. The waters were standing above the very mountains.
104.7: At your rebuke they began to flee; At the sound of your thunder they were sent running in panic -
104.8: Mountains proceeded to ascend, Valley plains proceeded to descend - To the place that you have founded for them.
104.9: A boundary you set, beyond which they should not pass, That they should not again cover the earth.
104.10: He is sending springs into the torrent valleys; Between the mountains they keep going on.
104.11: They continually give drink to all the wild beasts of the open field; The zebras regularly quench their thirst.
104.12: Above them roost the flying creatures of the heavens; From among the thick foliage they keep giving forth sound.
104.13: He is watering the mountains from his upper chambers. With the fruitage of your works the earth is satisfied.
104.14: He is making green grass sprout for the beasts, And vegetation for the service of mankind, To cause food to go forth from the earth,
104.15: And wine that makes the heart of mortal man rejoice, To make the face shine with oil, And bread that sustains the very heart of mortal man.
104.16: The trees of Jehovah are satisfied, The cedars of Leb'a·non that he planted,
104.17: Where the birds themselves make nests. As for the stork, the juniper trees are its house.
104.18: The high mountains are for the mountain goats; The crags are a refuge for the rock badgers.
104.19: He has made the moon for appointed times; The sun itself knows well where it sets.
104.20: You cause darkness, that it may become night; In it all the wild animals of the forest move forth.
104.21: The maned young lions are roaring for the prey And for seeking their food from God himself.
104.22: The sun begins to shine - they withdraw And they lie down in their own hiding places.
104.23: Man goes forth to his activity And to his service until evening.
104.24: How many your works are, O Jehovah! All of them in wisdom you have made. The earth is full of your productions.
104.25: As for this sea so great and wide, There there are moving things without number, Living creatures, small as well as great.
104.26: There the ships go; As for Le·vi'a·than, him you have formed to play about in it.
104.27: All of them - for you they keep waiting To give I [ them] their food in its season.
104.28: What you give them they pick up. You open your hand - they get satisfied with good things.
104.29: If you conceal your face, they get disturbed. If you take away their spirit, they expire, And back to their dust they go.
104.30: If you send forth your spirit, they are created; And you make the face of the ground new.
104.31: The glory of Jehovah will prove to be to time indefinite. Jehovah will rejoice in his works.
104.32: He is looking at the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
104.33: I will sing to Jehovah throughout my life; I will make melody to my God as long as I am.
104.34: Let my musing about him be pleasurable. I, for my part, shall rejoice in Jehovah.
104.35: The sinners will be finished off from the earth; And as for the wicked, they will be no longer. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise Jah, YOU people!

105.1: GIVE thanks to Jehovah, call upon his name, Make known among the peoples his dealings.
105.2: Sing to him, make melody to him, Concern yourselves with all his wonderful works.
105.3: Make YOUR boast in his holy name. Let the heart of those seeking Jehovah rejoice.
105.4: Search for Jehovah and his strength. Seek his face constantly.
105.5: Remember his wonderful works that he has performed, His miracles and the judicial decisions of his mouth,
105.6: O YOU seed of Abraham his servant, YOU sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.
105.7: He is Jehovah our God. His judicial decisions are in all the earth.
105.8: He has remembered his covenant even to time indefinite, The word that he commanded, to a thousand generations,
105.9: Which I [ covenant] he concluded with Abraham, And his sworn statement to Isaac,
105.10: And which I [ statement] he kept standing as a regulation even to Jacob, As an indefinitely lasting covenant even to Israel,
105.11: Saying: " To you I shall give the land of Ca'naan As the allotment of YOUR inheritance. "
105.12: I [ This was] when they happened to be few in number, Yes, very few, and alien residents in it.
105.13: And they kept walking about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.
105.14: He did not allow any human to defraud them, But on their account he reproved kings,
105.15: I [ Saying: ] " Do not YOU men touch my anointed ones, And to my prophets do nothing bad. "
105.16: And he proceeded to call for a famine upon the land; He broke every rod around which ring - shaped loaves were suspended.
105.17: He sent ahead of them a man Who was sold to be a slave, Joseph.
105.18: With fetters they afflicted his feet, Into irons his soul came;
105.19: Until the time that his word came, The saying of Jehovah itself refined him.
105.20: The king sent that he might release him, The ruler of the peoples, that he might let him loose.
105.21: He set him as master to his household And as ruler over all his property,
105.22: To bind his princes agreeably to his soul And that he might teach wisdom to even his elderly men.
105.23: And Israel proceeded to come into Egypt, And Jacob himself resided as an alien in the land of Ham.
105.24: And he kept making his people very fruitful, And gradually made them mightier than their adversaries.
105.25: He let their heart change to hate his people, To behave cunningly against his servants.
105.26: He sent Moses his servant, Aaron whom he had chosen.
105.27: They set among them the matters of his signs, And the miracles in the land of Ham.
105.28: He sent darkness and so made it dark; And they did not rebel against his words.
105.29: He changed their waters into blood, And proceeded to put their fish to death.
105.30: Their land swarmed with frogs, In the interior rooms of their kings.
105.31: He said that the gadflies should come in, Gnats in all their territories.
105.32: He made their downpours hail, A flaming fire on their land.
105.33: And he proceeded to strike their vines and their fig trees And to break the trees of their territory.
105.34: He said that the locusts should come in, And a species of locust, even without number.
105.35: And they went eating all the vegetation in their land; They also went eating the fruitage of their ground.
105.36: And he proceeded to strike down every firstborn in their land, The beginning of all their generative power.
105.37: And he began to bring them out with silver and gold; And among his tribes there was no one stumbling along.
105.38: Egypt rejoiced when they went out, For the dread of them had fallen upon them.
105.39: He spread out a cloud for a screen, And fire to give light by night.
105.40: They asked, and he proceeded to bring quails, And with bread from heaven he kept satisfying them.
105.41: He opened a rock, and waters began to flow out; These went through the waterless regions as a river.
105.42: For he remembered his holy word with Abraham his servant.
105.43: So he brought out his people with exultation, His chosen ones even with a joyful cry.
105.44: And gradually he gave them the lands of the nations, And they kept taking possession of the product of the hard work of national groups,
105.45: To the end that they might keep his regulations And observe his own laws. Praise Jah, YOU people!

106.1: Praise Jah, YOU people! Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good; For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite.
106.2: Who can utter the mighty performances of Jehovah, I [ Or] can make all his praise to be heard?
106.3: Happy are those observing justice, Doing righteousness all the time.
106.4: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the goodwill toward your people. Take care of me with your salvation,
106.5: That I may see the goodness to your chosen ones, That I may rejoice with the rejoicing of your nation, That I may make my boast with your inheritance.
106.6: We have sinned just the same as our forefathers; We have done wrong; we have acted wickedly.
106.7: As for our forefathers in Egypt, They did not show any insight into your wonderful works. They did not remember the abundance of your grand loving - kindness, But they behaved rebelliously at the sea, by the Red Sea.
106.8: And he proceeded to save them for the sake of his name, So as to make his mightiness known.
106.9: Accordingly he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was gradually dried up; And he went walking them through the watery deep as through the wilderness;
106.10: And so he saved them from the hand of the hater And reclaimed them from the hand of the enemy.
106.11: And the waters came covering their adversaries; Not one of them was left.
106.12: Then they had faith in his word; They began to sing his praise.
106.13: Quickly they forgot his works; They did not wait for his counsel.
106.14: But they showed their selfish desire in the wilderness And went putting God to the proof in the desert.
106.15: And he proceeded to give them their request And to send a wasting disease into their soul.
106.16: And they began to envy Moses in the camp, Even Aaron the holy one of Jehovah.
106.17: The earth then opened up and swallowed down Da'than, And covered over the assembly of A·bi'ram.
106.18: And a fire went burning among their assembly; A flame itself went devouring the wicked ones.
106.19: Furthermore, they made a calf in Ho'reb And bowed down to a molten image,
106.20: So that they exchanged my glory For a representation of a bull, an eater of vegetation.
106.21: They forgot God their Savior, The Doer of great things in Egypt,
106.22: Wonderful works in the land of Ham, Fear - inspiring things at the Red Sea.
106.23: And he was about to say to annihilate them, If it had not been for Moses his chosen one, Who stood in the gap before him, To turn back his rage from bringing I [ them] to ruin.
106.24: And they got to contemning the desirable land; They had no faith in his word.
106.25: And they kept grumbling in their tents; They did not listen to the voice of Jehovah.
106.26: So he proceeded to raise his hand I [ in an oath] concerning them, That he would make them fall in the wilderness,
106.27: And that he would make their offspring fall among the nations, And that he would scatter them among the lands.
106.28: And they began to attach themselves to Ba'al of Pe'or And to eat the sacrifices of the dead ones.
106.29: As they were causing offense by their dealings, A scourge now broke out among them.
106.30: When Phin'e·has stood up and intervened, Then the scourge was halted.
106.31: And it came to be counted to him as righteousness For generation after generation to time indefinite.
106.32: Further, they caused provocation at the waters of Mer'i·bah, So that it went badly with Moses by reason of them.
106.33: For they embittered his spirit And he began to speak rashly with his lips.
106.34: They did not annihilate the peoples, As Jehovah had said to them.
106.35: And they went mingling with the nations And took up learning their works.
106.36: And they kept serving their idols, And these came to be a snare to them.
106.37: And they would sacrifice their sons And their daughters to demons.
106.38: So they kept spilling innocent blood, The blood of their sons and their daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Ca'naan; And the land came to be polluted with bloodshed.
106.39: And they got to be unclean by their works And kept having immoral intercourse by their dealings.
106.40: And the anger of Jehovah began to blaze against his people, And he came to detest his inheritance.
106.41: And he repeatedly gave them into the hand of the nations, That those hating them might rule over them,
106.42: And that their enemies might oppress them, And that they might be subdued under their hand.
106.43: Many times he would deliver them, But they themselves would behave rebelliously in their disobedient course, And they would be brought low for their error.
106.44: And he would see the distress of theirs When he heard their entreating cry.
106.45: And he would remember concerning them his covenant, And he would feel regret according to the abundance of his grand loving - kindness.
106.46: And he would grant them to be objects of pity Before all those holding them captive.
106.47: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And collect us together from the nations To give thanks to your holy name, To speak exultingly in your praise.
106.48: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel From time indefinite even to time indefinite; And all the people must say Amen. Praise Jah, YOU people!

107.1: O give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good; For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite.
107.2: Let the reclaimed ones of Jehovah say so, Whom he has reclaimed from the hand of the adversary,
107.3: And whom he has collected together even from the lands, From the sunrise and from the sunset, From the north and from the south.
107.4: They wandered about in the wilderness, in the desert; They did not find any way to a city of habitation.
107.5: They were hungry, also thirsty; Their very soul within them began to faint away.
107.6: And they kept crying out to Jehovah in their distress; Out of the stresses upon them he proceeded to deliver them,
107.7: And to have them walk in the right way, So as to come to a city of habitation.
107.8: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving - kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.
107.9: For he has satisfied the dried - out soul; And the hungry soul he has filled with good things.
107.10: There were those dwelling in darkness and deep shadow, Prisoners in affliction and irons.
107.11: For they had behaved rebelliously against the sayings of God; And the counsel of the Most High they had disrespected.
107.12: So with trouble he proceeded to subdue their heart; They stumbled, and there was no one helping.
107.13: And they began calling to Jehovah for help in their distress; Out of the stresses upon them he as usual saved them.
107.14: He went bringing them out from darkness and deep shadow, And tearing even their bands apart.
107.15: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving - kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.
107.16: For he has broken the doors of copper, And he has cut down even the bars of iron.
107.17: Those who were foolish, due to the way of their transgression And due to their errors, finally caused themselves affliction.
107.18: Their soul got to detest even every sort of food, And they were arriving at the gates of death.
107.19: And they began calling to Jehovah for help in their distress; Out of the stresses upon them he as usual saved them.
107.20: He proceeded to send his word and heal them And to provide I [ them] escape out of their pits.
107.21: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving - kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.
107.22: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving And declare his works with a joyful cry.
107.23: Those going down to the sea in the ships, Doing business on vast waters,
107.24: They are the ones that have seen the works of Jehovah And his wonderful works in the depths;
107.25: How he says I [ the word] and causes a tempestuous wind to arise, So that it lifts up its waves.
107.26: They go up to the heavens, They go down to the bottoms. Because of the calamity their very soul finds itself melting.
107.27: They reel and move unsteadily like a drunken man, And even all their wisdom proves confused.
107.28: And they begin crying out to Jehovah in their distress, And out of the stresses upon them he brings them forth.
107.29: He causes the windstorm to stand at a calm, So that the waves of the sea keep quiet.
107.30: And they rejoice because these become still, And he leads them to the haven of their delight.
107.31: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving - kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.
107.32: And let them extol him in the congregation of the people; And in the seat of the elderly men let them praise him.
107.33: He converts rivers into a wilderness, And the outflows of water into thirsty ground,
107.34: Fruitful land into salt country, Owing to the badness of those dwelling in it.
107.35: He converts a wilderness into a reedy pool of water, And the land of a waterless region into outflows of water.
107.36: And there he causes the hungry ones to dwell, So that they firmly establish a city of habitation.
107.37: And they sow fields and plant vineyards, That they may yield fruitful crops.
107.38: And he blesses them so that they become very many; And he does not let their cattle become few.
107.39: Again they become few and crouch down Owing to restraint, calamity and grief.
107.40: He is pouring out contempt upon nobles, So that he makes them wander about in a featureless place, where there is no way.
107.41: But he protects the poor one from affliction And converts him into families just like a flock.
107.42: The upright ones see and rejoice; But as for all unrighteousness, it has to shut its mouth.
107.43: Who is wise? He will both observe these things And show himself attentive toward Jehovah's acts of loving - kindness.

108.1: My heart is steadfast, O God. I will sing and make melody, Even my glory.
108.2: Do awake, O stringed instrument; you too, O harp. I will awaken the dawn.
108.3: I shall laud you among the peoples, O Jehovah; And I shall make melody to you among the national groups.
108.4: For your loving - kindness is great up to the heavens, And your trueness up to the skies.
108.5: O be exalted above the heavens, O God; And let your glory be above all the earth.
108.6: In order that your beloved ones may be rescued, O do save with your right hand and answer me.
108.7: God himself has spoken in his holiness: " I will exult, I will give out She'chem as a portion; And the low plain of Suc'coth I shall measure off.
108.8: Gil'e·ad belongs to me; Ma·nas'seh belongs to me; And E'phra·im is the fortress of my head one; Judah is my commander's staff.
108.9: Mo'ab is my washing pot. Over E'dom I shall throw my sandal. Over Phi·lis'ti·a I shall shout in triumph. "
108.10: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will actually lead me as far as E'dom?
108.11: Is it not I [ you], O God, who have cast us off And who do not go forth with our armies as God?
108.12: Do give us assistance from distress, As salvation by earthling man is worthless.
108.13: By God we shall gain vital energy, And he himself will tread down our adversaries.

109.1: O God of my praise, do not keep silent.
109.2: For the mouth of the wicked one and the mouth of deception have opened against me. They have spoken about me with the tongue of falsehood;
109.3: And with words of hatred they have surrounded me, And they keep fighting against me without cause.
109.4: For my love they keep resisting me; But on my part there is prayer.
109.5: And they render to me bad for good And hatred for my love.
109.6: Appoint over him someone wicked, And may a resister himself keep standing at his right hand.
109.7: When he is judged, let him go forth as someone wicked; And let his very prayer become a sin.
109.8: Let his days prove to be few; His office of oversight let someone else take.
109.9: Let his sons become fatherless boys And his wife be a widow.
109.10: And without fail let his sons go wandering about; And they must do begging, And they must look for I [ food] from their desolate places.
109.11: Let the usurer lay out traps for all that he has, And let strangers make plunder of his product of toil.
109.12: May he come to have no one extending loving - kindness, And may there prove to be no one showing favor to his fatherless boys.
109.13: Let his posterity be for cutting off. In the following generation let their name be wiped out.
109.14: Let the error of his forefathers be remembered to Jehovah, And the sin of his mother - may it not be wiped out.
109.15: Let them prove to be in front of Jehovah constantly; And may he cut off the remembrance of them from the very earth;
109.16: For the reason that he did not remember to exercise loving - kindness, But he kept pursuing the afflicted and poor man And the one dejected at heart, to put I [ him] to death.
109.17: And he kept loving the malediction, so that it came upon him; And he did not take delight in the blessing, So that it became far away from him;
109.18: And he came to be clothed with malediction as his garment. So it came like waters into the midst of him And like oil into his bones.
109.19: May it prove to be for him like a garment with which he enwraps himself And as a girdle that he keeps girded about himself constantly.
109.20: This is the wages from Jehovah of the one resisting me And of those speaking evil against my soul.
109.21: But you are Jehovah the Sovereign Lord. Deal with me for the sake of your name. Because your loving - kindness is good, deliver me.
109.22: For I am afflicted and poor, And my heart itself has been pierced within me.
109.23: Like a shadow when it declines, I am obliged to go away; I have been shaken off like a locust.
109.24: My knees themselves have swayed from fasting, And my very flesh has grown lean, without any oil.
109.25: And to them I myself have become something reproachable. They see me - they begin wagging their head.
109.26: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Save me according to your loving - kindness.
109.27: And may they know that this is your hand; That you yourself, O Jehovah, have done it.
109.28: Let them, for their part, pronounce a malediction, But may you, for your part, pronounce a blessing. They have risen up, but let them be ashamed, And let your own servant rejoice.
109.29: Let those resisting me be clothed with humiliation, And let them enwrap themselves with their shame just as with a sleeveless coat.
109.30: I shall laud Jehovah very much with my mouth, And in among many people I shall praise him.
109.31: For he will stand at the right hand of the poor, To save I [ him] from those judging his soul.

110.1: The utterance of Jehovah to my Lord is: " Sit at my right hand Until I place your enemies as a stool for your feet. "
110.2: The rod of your strength Jehovah will send out of Zion, I [ saying: ] " Go subduing in the midst of your enemies. "
110.3: Your people will offer themselves willingly on the day of your military force. In the splendors of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, You have your company of young men just like dewdrops.
110.4: Jehovah has sworn ( and he will feel no regret ): " You are a priest to time indefinite According to the manner of Mel·chiz'e·dek! "
110.5: Jehovah himself at your right hand Will certainly break kings to pieces on the day of his anger.
110.6: He will execute judgment among the nations; He will cause a fullness of dead bodies. He will certainly break to pieces the head one over a populous land.
110.7: From the torrent valley in the way he will drink. That is why he will raise high I [ his] head.

111.1: Praise Jah, YOU people! I shall laud Jehovah with all I [ my] heart In the intimate group of upright ones and the assembly.
111.2: The works of Jehovah are great, Searched for on the part of all those delighting in them.
111.3: His activity is dignity and splendor themselves, And his righteousness is standing forever.
111.4: A memorial he has made for his wonderful works. Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
111.5: Food he has given to those fearing him. To time indefinite he will remember his covenant.
111.6: The power of his works he has told to his people, In giving them the inheritance of the nations.
111.7: The works of his hands are truth and judgment; Trustworthy are all the orders he gives,
111.8: Well supported forever, to time indefinite, Done in truth and uprightness.
111.9: He has sent redemption itself to his people. To time indefinite he has commanded his covenant. His name is holy and fear - inspiring.
111.10: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom. All those doing them have a good insight. His praise is standing forever.

112.1: Praise Jah, YOU people! Happy is the man in fear of Jehovah, In whose commandments he has taken very much delight.
112.2: Mighty in the earth his offspring will become. As for the generation of the upright ones, it will be blessed.
112.3: Valuable things and riches are in his house; And his righteousness is standing forever.
112.4: He has flashed up in the darkness as a light to the upright ones. He is gracious and merciful and righteous.
112.5: The man is good who is gracious and is lending. He sustains his affairs with justice.
112.6: For at no time will he be made to totter. The righteous one will prove to be for remembrance to time indefinite.
112.7: He will not be afraid even of bad news. His heart is steadfast, made reliant upon Jehovah.
112.8: His heart is unshakable; he will not be afraid, Until he looks on his adversaries.
112.9: He has distributed widely; he has given to the poor ones. His righteousness is standing forever. His own horn will be exalted with glory.
112.10: The wicked one himself will see and certainly become vexed. He will grind his very teeth and actually melt away. The desire of the wicked ones will perish.

113.1: Praise Jah, YOU people! Offer praise, O YOU servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
113.2: May Jehovah's name become blessed From now on and to time indefinite.
113.3: From the rising of the sun until its setting Jehovah's name is to be praised.
113.4: Jehovah has become high above all the nations; His glory is above the heavens.
113.5: Who is like Jehovah our God, Him who is making his dwelling on high?
113.6: He is condescending to look on heaven and earth,
113.7: Raising up the lowly one from the very dust; He exalts the poor one from the ashpit itself,
113.8: To make I [ him] sit with nobles, With the nobles of his people.
113.9: He is causing the barren woman to dwell in a house As a joyful mother of sons. Praise Jah, YOU people!

114.1: When Israel went forth from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people speaking unintelligibly,
114.2: Judah became his holy place, Israel his grand dominion.
114.3: The sea itself saw and took to flight; As for the Jordan, it began to turn back.
114.4: The mountains themselves skipped about like rams, The hills like lambs.
114.5: What was the matter with you, O sea, that you took to flight, O Jordan, that you began to turn back?
114.6: O mountains, that YOU went skipping about like rams; O hills, like lambs?
114.7: Because of the Lord be in severe pains, O earth, Because of the God of Jacob,
114.8: Who is changing the rock into a reedy pool of water, A flinty rock into a spring of water.

115.1: To us belongs nothing, O Jehovah, to us belongs nothing, But to your name give glory According to your loving - kindness, according to your trueness.
115.2: Why should the nations say: " Where, now, is their God? "
115.3: But our God is in the heavens; Everything that he delighted I [ to do] he has done.
115.4: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of the hands of earthling man.
115.5: A mouth they have, but they cannot speak; Eyes they have, but they cannot see;
115.6: Ears they have, but they cannot hear. A nose they have, but they cannot smell.
115.7: Hands are theirs, but they cannot feel. Feet are theirs, but they cannot walk; They utter no sound with their throat.
115.8: Those making them will become just like them, All those who are trusting in them.
115.9: O Israel, trust in Jehovah; He is their help and their shield.
115.10: O house of Aaron, put YOUR trust in Jehovah; He is their help and their shield.
115.11: YOU that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah; He is their help and their shield.
115.12: Jehovah himself has remembered us; he will bless, He will bless the house of Israel, He will bless the house of Aaron.
115.13: He will bless those fearing Jehovah, The small ones as well as the great ones.
115.14: Jehovah will give increase to YOU, To YOU and to YOUR sons.
115.15: YOU are the ones blessed by Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.
115.16: As regards the heavens, to Jehovah the heavens belong, But the earth he has given to the sons of men.
115.17: The dead themselves do not praise Jah, Nor do any going down into silence.
115.18: But we ourselves will bless Jah From now on and to time indefinite. Praise Jah, YOU people!

116.1: I do love, because Jehovah hears My voice, my entreaties.
116.2: For he has inclined his ear to me, And throughout my days I shall call.
116.3: The ropes of death encircled me And the distressing circumstances of She'ol themselves found me. Distress and grief I kept finding.
116.4: But upon the name of Jehovah I proceeded to call: " Ah, Jehovah, do provide my soul with escape! "
116.5: Jehovah is gracious and righteous; And our God is One showing mercy.
116.6: Jehovah is guarding the inexperienced ones. I was impoverished, and he proceeded to save even me.
116.7: Return to your resting - place, O my soul, For Jehovah himself has acted appropriately toward you.
116.8: For you have rescued my soul from death, My eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.
116.9: I will walk before Jehovah in the lands of those living.
116.10: I had faith, for I proceeded to speak. I myself was very much afflicted.
116.11: I, for my part, said, when I became panicky: " Every man is a liar. "
116.12: What shall I repay to Jehovah For all his benefits to me?
116.13: The cup of grand salvation I shall take up, And on the name of Jehovah I shall call.
116.14: My vows I shall pay to Jehovah, Yes, in front of all his people.
116.15: Precious in the eyes of Jehovah Is the death of his loyal ones.
116.16: Ah, now, O Jehovah, For I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your slave girl. You have loosened my bands.
116.17: To you I shall offer the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And on the name of Jehovah I shall call.
116.18: My vows I shall pay to Jehovah, Yes, in front of all his people,
116.19: In the courtyards of the house of Jehovah, In the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise Jah, YOU people!

117.1: Praise Jehovah, all YOU nations; Commend him, all YOU clans.
117.2: For toward us his loving - kindness has proved mighty; And the trueness of Jehovah is to time indefinite. Praise Jah, YOU people!

118.1: Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good; For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite.
118.2: Let Israel now say: " For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite. "
118.3: Let those of the house of Aaron now say: " For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite. "
118.4: Let those fearing Jehovah now say: " For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite. "
118.5: Out of the distressing circumstances I called upon Jah; Jah answered I [ and put] me into a roomy place.
118.6: Jehovah is on my side; I shall not fear. What can earthling man do to me?
118.7: Jehovah is on my side among those helping me, So that I myself shall look upon those hating me.
118.8: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to trust in earthling man.
118.9: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to trust in nobles.
118.10: All the nations themselves surrounded me. It was in the name of Jehovah that I kept holding them off.
118.11: They surrounded me, yes, they had me surrounded. It was in the name of Jehovah that I kept holding them off.
118.12: They surrounded me like bees; They were extinguished like a fire of thornbushes. It was in the name of Jehovah that I kept holding them off.
118.13: You pushed me hard that I should fall, But Jehovah himself helped me.
118.14: Jah is my shelter and I [ my] might, And to me he becomes salvation.
118.15: The voice of a joyful cry and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous ones. The right hand of Jehovah is demonstrating vital energy.
118.16: The right hand of Jehovah is exalting I [ itself]; The right hand of Jehovah is demonstrating vital energy.
118.17: I shall not die, but I shall keep living, That I may declare the works of Jah.
118.18: Jah corrected me severely, But he did not give me over to death itself.
118.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, YOU people. I shall go into them; I shall laud Jah.
118.20: This is the gate of Jehovah. The righteous themselves will go into it.
118.21: I shall laud you, for you answered me And you came to be my salvation.
118.22: The stone that the builders rejected Has become the head of the corner.
118.23: This has come to be from Jehovah himself; It is wonderful in our eyes.
118.24: This is the day that Jehovah has made; We will be joyful and rejoice in it.
118.25: Ah, now, Jehovah, do save, please! Ah, now, Jehovah, do grant success, please!
118.26: Blessed be the One coming in the name of Jehovah; We have blessed YOU people out of the house of Jehovah.
118.27: Jehovah is the Divine One, And he gives us light. Bind the festival procession with boughs, O YOU people, As far as the horns of the altar.
118.28: You are my Divine One, and I shall laud you; My God - I shall exalt you.
118.29: Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good; For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite.

119.1: Happy are the ones faultless in I [ their] way, The ones walking in the law of Jehovah.
119.2: Happy are those observing his reminders; With all the heart they keep searching for him.
119.3: Really they have practiced no unrighteousness. In his ways they have walked.
119.4: You yourself have commandingly given your orders To be carefully kept.
119.5: O that my ways were firmly established To keep your regulations!
119.6: In that case I should not be ashamed, When I look to all your commandments.
119.7: I shall laud you in uprightness of heart, When I learn your righteous judicial decisions.
119.8: Your regulations I continue to keep. O do not leave me entirely.
119.9: How will a young man cleanse his path? By keeping on guard according to your word.
119.10: With my whole heart I have searched for you. Do not cause me to go astray from your commandments.
119.11: In my heart I have treasured up your saying, In order that I may not sin against you.
119.12: Blessed you are, O Jehovah. Teach me your regulations.
119.13: With my lips I have declared All the judicial decisions of your mouth.
119.14: In the way of your reminders I have exulted, Just as over all other valuable things.
119.15: With your orders I will concern myself, And I will look to your paths.
119.16: For your statutes I shall show a fondness. I shall not forget your word.
119.17: Act appropriately toward your servant, that I may live And that I may keep your word.
119.18: Uncover my eyes, that I may look At the wonderful things out of your law.
119.19: I am but an alien resident in the land. Do not conceal from me your commandments.
119.20: My soul is crushed with longing For your judicial decisions all the time.
119.21: You have rebuked the cursed presumptuous ones, Who are straying from your commandments.
119.22: Roll off me reproach and contempt, For I have observed your own reminders.
119.23: Even princes have sat; against me they have spoken with one another. As for your servant, he concerns himself with your regulations.
119.24: Also, your reminders are what I am fond of, As men of my counsel.
119.25: My soul has been cleaving to the very dust. Preserve me alive according to your word.
119.26: I have declared my own ways, that you may answer me. Teach me your regulations.
119.27: Make me understand the way of your own orders, That I may concern myself with your wonderful works.
119.28: My soul has been sleepless from grief. Raise me up according to your word.
119.29: Remove from me even the false way, And favor me with your own law.
119.30: The way of faithfulness I have chosen. Your judicial decisions I have considered appropriate.
119.31: I have cleaved to your reminders. O Jehovah, do not put me to shame.
119.32: I shall run the very way of your commandments, Because you make my heart have the room.
119.33: Instruct me, O Jehovah, in the way of your regulations, That I may observe it down to the last.
119.34: Make me understand, that I may observe your law And that I may keep it with the whole heart.
119.35: Cause me to tread in the pathway of your commandments, For in it I have taken delight.
119.36: Incline my heart to your reminders, And not to profits.
119.37: Make my eyes pass on from seeing what is worthless; Preserve me alive in your own way.
119.38: Carry out to your servant your saying That I [ tends] to the fear of you.
119.39: Make my reproach pass away, of which I have been scared, For your judicial decisions are good.
119.40: Look! I have longed for your orders. In your righteousness preserve me alive.
119.41: And may your loving - kindnesses come to me, O Jehovah, Your salvation according to your saying,
119.42: That I may answer the one reproaching me with a word, For I have trusted in your word.
119.43: And do not take away from my mouth the word of truth entirely, For I have waited for your own judicial decision.
119.44: And I will keep your law constantly, To time indefinite, even forever.
119.45: And I will walk about in a roomy place, For I have searched even for your orders.
119.46: I will also speak about your reminders in front of kings, And I shall not be ashamed.
119.47: And I shall show a fondness for your commandments That I have loved.
119.48: And I shall raise my palms to your commandments that I have loved, And I will concern myself with your regulations.
119.49: Remember the word to your servant, For which you have made me wait.
119.50: This is my comfort in my affliction, For your own saying has preserved me alive.
119.51: The presumptuous ones themselves have derided me to the extreme. From your law I have not deviated.
119.52: I have remembered your judicial decisions from time indefinite, O Jehovah, And I find comfort for myself.
119.53: A raging heat itself has taken hold of me because of the wicked, Who are leaving your law.
119.54: Melodies your regulations have become to me In the house of my alien residences.
119.55: In the night I have remembered your name, O Jehovah, That I may keep your law.
119.56: Even this has become mine, Because your orders I have observed.
119.57: Jehovah is my share; I have promised to keep your words.
119.58: I have softened your face with all I [ my] heart. Show me favor according to your saying.
119.59: I have considered my ways, That I may turn back my feet to your reminders.
119.60: I hurried up, and I did not delay To keep your commandments.
119.61: The very ropes of the wicked ones surrounded me. Your law I did not forget.
119.62: At midnight I get up to give thanks to you For your righteous judicial decisions.
119.63: A partner I am of all those who do fear you, And of those keeping your orders.
119.64: Your loving - kindness, O Jehovah, has filled the earth. Teach me your own regulations.
119.65: You have dealt well indeed with your servant, O Jehovah, according to your word.
119.66: Teach me goodness, sensibleness and knowledge themselves, For in your commandments I have exercised faith.
119.67: Before I was under affliction I was sinning by mistake, But now I have kept your very saying.
119.68: You are good and are doing good. Teach me your regulations.
119.69: The presumptuous have smeared me with falsehood. As for me, with all I [ my] heart I shall observe your orders.
119.70: Their heart has become unfeeling just like fat. I, for my part, have been fond of your own law.
119.71: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I may learn your regulations.
119.72: The law of your mouth is good for me, More so than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
119.73: Your own hands have made me, and they proceeded to fix me solidly. Make me understand, that I may learn your commandments.
119.74: Those fearing you are the ones that see me and rejoice, For I have waited for your own word.
119.75: I well know, O Jehovah, that your judicial decisions are righteousness And that with faithfulness you have afflicted me.
119.76: May your loving - kindness serve, please, to comfort me, According to your saying to your servant.
119.77: Let your mercies come to me, that I may keep living; For your law is what I am fond of.
119.78: Let the presumptuous ones be ashamed, for without cause they have misled me. As for me, I concern myself with your orders.
119.79: Let those fearing you turn back to me, Those also knowing your reminders.
119.80: Let my heart prove faultless in your regulations, In order that I may not be ashamed.
119.81: For your salvation my soul has pined away; For your word I have waited.
119.82: My eyes have pined away for your saying, While I say: " When will you comfort me? "
119.83: For I have become like a skin bottle in the smoke. Your regulations I have not forgotten.
119.84: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment against those persecuting me?
119.85: The presumptuous have excavated pitfalls to get me, Those who are not in accord with your law.
119.86: All your commandments are faithfulness itself. Without cause they have persecuted me. O help me.
119.87: In a little while they would have exterminated me in the earth; But I myself did not leave your orders.
119.88: According to your loving - kindness preserve me alive, That I may keep the reminder of your mouth.
119.89: To time indefinite, O Jehovah, Your word is stationed in the heavens.
119.90: Your faithfulness is for generation after generation. You have solidly fixed the earth, that it may keep standing.
119.91: According to your judicial decisions they have stood I [ till] today, For they are all your servants.
119.92: If your law had not been what I am fond of, Then I should have perished in my affliction.
119.93: To time indefinite I shall not forget your orders, Because by them you have preserved me alive.
119.94: I am yours. O save me, Because I have searched for your own orders.
119.95: For me the wicked have waited, to destroy me. To your reminders I keep showing myself attentive.
119.96: To all perfection I have seen an end. Your commandment is very broad.
119.97: How I do love your law! All day long it is my concern.
119.98: Wiser than my enemies your commandment makes me, Because to time indefinite it is mine.
119.99: More insight than all my teachers I have come to have, Because your reminders are a concern to me.
119.100: With more understanding than older men I behave, Because I have observed your own orders.
119.101: From every bad path I have restrained my feet, For the purpose that I may keep your word.
119.102: From your judicial decisions I have not turned aside, For you yourself have instructed me.
119.103: How smooth to my palate your sayings have been, More so than honey to my mouth!
119.104: Owing to your orders I behave with understanding. That is why I have hated every false path.
119.105: Your word is a lamp to my foot, And a light to my roadway.
119.106: I have made a sworn statement, and I will carry it out, To keep your righteous judicial decisions.
119.107: I have been afflicted to a great extent. O Jehovah, preserve me alive according to your word.
119.108: Please take pleasure in the voluntary offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me your own judicial decisions.
119.109: My soul is in my palm constantly; But your law I have not forgotten.
119.110: The wicked have set a trap for me, But from your orders I have not wandered.
119.111: I have taken your reminders as a possession to time indefinite, For they are the exultation of my heart.
119.112: I have inclined my heart to do your regulations To time indefinite, down to the last.
119.113: The halfhearted ones I have hated, But your law I have loved.
119.114: You are my place of concealment and my shield. For your word I have waited.
119.115: Get away from me, YOU evildoers, That I may observe the commandments of my God.
119.116: Support me according to your saying, that I may keep living, And do not put me to shame for my hope.
119.117: Sustain me, that I may be saved, And I shall gaze upon your regulations constantly.
119.118: You have tossed away all those straying from your regulations; For their trickiness is falsehood.
119.119: As scummy dross you have made all the wicked ones of the earth to cease. Therefore I have loved your reminders.
119.120: From the dread of you my flesh has had a creepy feeling; And because of your judicial decisions I have been afraid.
119.121: I have executed judgment and righteousness. O do not abandon me to those defrauding me!
119.122: Act as a surety for your servant for what is good. May the presumptuous ones not defraud me.
119.123: My very eyes have pined away for your salvation And for your righteous saying.
119.124: Do with your servant according to your loving - kindness, And teach me your own regulations.
119.125: I am your servant. Make me understand, That I may know your reminders.
119.126: It is the time for Jehovah to act. They have broken your law.
119.127: That is why I have loved your commandments More than gold, even refined gold.
119.128: That is why I have considered all orders regarding all things to be right; Every false path I have hated.
119.129: Your reminders are wonderful. That is why my soul has observed them.
119.130: The very disclosure of your words gives light, Making the inexperienced ones understand.
119.131: My mouth I have opened wide, that I may pant, Because for your commandments I have longed.
119.132: Turn to me and show me favor, According to I [ your] judicial decision toward those loving your name.
119.133: Fix my own steps solidly in your saying, And may no kind of hurtful thing domineer over me.
119.134: Redeem me from any defrauder of mankind, And I will keep your orders.
119.135: Make your own face shine upon your servant, And teach me your regulations.
119.136: Streams of water have run down my eyes Over the fact that they have not kept your law.
119.137: You are righteous, O Jehovah, And your judicial decisions are upright.
119.138: You have commanded your reminders in righteousness And in exceeding faithfulness.
119.139: My ardor has made an end of me, Because my adversaries have forgotten your words.
119.140: Your saying is very much refined, And your own servant loves it.
119.141: I am insignificant and contemptible. Your orders I have not forgotten.
119.142: Your righteousness is a righteousness to time indefinite, And your law is truth.
119.143: Distress and difficulty themselves found me. Your commandments I was fond of.
119.144: The righteousness of your reminders is to time indefinite. Make me understand, that I may keep living.
119.145: I have called with I [ my] whole heart. Answer me, O Jehovah. Your regulations I will observe.
119.146: I have called upon you. O save me! And I will keep your reminders.
119.147: I have been up early in the morning twilight, that I may cry for help. For your words I have waited.
119.148: My eyes have been ahead of the night watches, I [ For me] to concern myself with your saying.
119.149: O do hear my own voice according to your loving - kindness. O Jehovah, according to your judicial decision preserve me alive.
119.150: Those in pursuit of loose conduct have come near; They have got far away from your own law.
119.151: You are near, O Jehovah, And all your commandments are truth.
119.152: Long ago I have known some of your reminders, For to time indefinite you have founded them.
119.153: O see my affliction, and rescue me; For I have not forgotten your own law.
119.154: O do conduct my legal case and recover me; Preserve me alive in agreement with your saying.
119.155: Salvation is far away from the wicked ones, For they have not searched for your own regulations.
119.156: Many are your mercies, O Jehovah. According to your judicial decisions, O preserve me alive.
119.157: My persecutors and my adversaries are many. From your reminders I have not deviated.
119.158: I have seen those who are treacherous in dealing, And I do feel a loathing, because they have not kept your own saying.
119.159: O see that I have loved your own orders. O Jehovah, according to your loving - kindness preserve me alive.
119.160: The substance of your word is truth, And every righteous judicial decision of yours is to time indefinite.
119.161: Princes themselves have persecuted me for no cause, But my heart has been in dread of your own words.
119.162: I am exulting over your saying Just as one does when finding much spoil.
119.163: Falsehood I have hated, and I do keep detesting it. Your law I have loved.
119.164: Seven times in the day I have praised you Because of your righteous judicial decisions.
119.165: Abundant peace belongs to those loving your law, And for them there is no stumbling block.
119.166: I have hoped for your salvation, O Jehovah, And I have done your own commandments.
119.167: My soul has kept your reminders, And I love them exceedingly.
119.168: I have kept your orders and your reminders, For all my ways are in front of you.
119.169: May my entreating cry come near before you, O Jehovah. According to your word, O make me understand.
119.170: May my request for favor enter in before you. According to your saying, O deliver me.
119.171: May my lips bubble forth praise, For you teach me your regulations.
119.172: May my tongue sing forth your saying, For all your commandments are righteousness.
119.173: May your hand serve to help me, Because your orders I have chosen.
119.174: I have longed for your salvation, O Jehovah, And your law I am fond of.
119.175: May my soul keep living and praising you, And may your own judicial decisions help me.
119.176: I have wandered like a lost sheep. O look for your servant, For I have not forgotten your own commandments.

120.1: To Jehovah I called in the distress of mine, And he proceeded to answer me.
120.2: O Jehovah, do deliver my soul from false lips, From the tricky tongue.
120.3: What will one give to you, and what will one add to you, O you tricky tongue?
120.4: Sharpened arrows of a mighty man, Along with burning coals of the broom trees.
120.5: Woe to me, for I have resided as an alien in Me'shech! I have tabernacled together with the tents of Ke'dar.
120.6: For too long a time my soul has tabernacled With the haters of peace.
120.7: I stand for peace; but when I speak, They are for war.

121.1: I shall raise my eyes to the mountains. From where will my help come?
121.2: My help is from Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.
121.3: He cannot possibly allow your foot to totter. The One guarding you cannot possibly be drowsy.
121.4: Look! He will not be drowsy nor go to sleep, He that is guarding Israel.
121.5: Jehovah is guarding you. Jehovah is your shade on your right hand.
121.6: By day the sun itself will not strike you, Nor the moon by night.
121.7: Jehovah himself will guard you against all calamity. He will guard your soul.
121.8: Jehovah himself will guard your going out and your coming in From now on and to time indefinite.

122.1: I rejoiced when they were saying to me: " To the house of Jehovah let us go. "
122.2: Our feet proved to be standing Within your gates, O Jerusalem.
122.3: Jerusalem is one that is built like a city That has been joined together in oneness,
122.4: To which the tribes have gone up, The tribes of Jah, As a reminder to Israel To give thanks to the name of Jehovah.
122.5: For there the thrones for judgment have been sitting, Thrones for the house of David.
122.6: Ask, O YOU people, for the peace of Jerusalem. Those loving you, I [ O city, ] will be free from care.
122.7: May peace continue within your rampart, Freedom from care within your dwelling towers.
122.8: For the sake of my brothers and my companions I will now speak: " May there be peace within you. "
122.9: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will keep seeking good for you.

123.1: To you I have raised my eyes, O You who are dwelling in the heavens.
123.2: Look! As the eyes of servants are toward the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maidservant are toward the hand of her mistress, So our eyes are toward Jehovah our God Until he shows us favor.
123.3: Show us favor, O Jehovah, show us favor; For to an abundance we have been glutted with contempt.
123.4: Abundantly our soul has been glutted with the derision of those who are at ease, Of the contempt on the part of the arrogant ones.

124.1: " Had it not been that Jehovah proved to be for us, " Let Israel now say,
124.2: " Had it not been that Jehovah proved to be for us When men rose up against us,
124.3: Then they would have swallowed us up even alive, When their anger was burning against us.
124.4: Then the very waters would have washed us away, The torrent itself would have passed over our soul.
124.5: Then there would have passed over our soul The waters of presumptuousness.
124.6: Blessed be Jehovah, who has not given us As a prey to their teeth.
124.7: Our soul is like a bird that is escaped From the trap of baiters. The trap is broken, And we ourselves have escaped.
124.8: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth. "

125.1: Those trusting in Jehovah Are like Mount Zion, which cannot be made to totter, but dwells even to time indefinite.
125.2: Jerusalem - as mountains are all around it, So Jehovah is all around his people From now on and to time indefinite.
125.3: For the scepter of wickedness will not keep resting upon the lot of the righteous ones, In order that the righteous ones may not thrust out their hand upon any wrongdoing.
125.4: O do good, O Jehovah, to the good ones, Even to the ones upright in their hearts.
125.5: As for those turning aside to their crooked ways, Jehovah will make them go away with the practicers of what is hurtful. There will be peace upon Israel.

126.1: When Jehovah gathered back the captive ones of Zion, We became like those who were dreaming.
126.2: At that time our mouth came to be filled with laughter, And our tongue with a joyful cry. At that time they proceeded to say among the nations: " Jehovah has done a great thing in what he has done with them. "
126.3: Jehovah has done a great thing in what he has done with us. We have become joyful.
126.4: Do gather back, O Jehovah, our company of captives, Like streambeds in the Neg'eb.
126.5: Those sowing seed with tears Will reap even with a joyful cry.
126.6: The one that without fail goes forth, even weeping, Carrying along a bagful of seed, Will without fail come in with a joyful cry, Carrying along his sheaves.

127.1: Unless Jehovah himself builds the house, It is to no avail that its builders have worked hard on it. Unless Jehovah himself guards the city, It is to no avail that the guard has kept awake.
127.2: To no avail it is for YOU men that YOU are rising up early, That YOU are sitting down late, That YOU are eating food with pains. Just like this he gives sleep even to his beloved one.
127.3: Look! Sons are an inheritance from Jehovah; The fruitage of the belly is a reward.
127.4: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the sons of youth.
127.5: Happy is the able - bodied man that has filled his quiver with them. They will not be ashamed, For they will speak with enemies in the gate.

128.1: Happy is everyone fearing Jehovah, Who is walking in his ways.
128.2: For you will eat the toil of your own hands. Happy you will be and it will be well with you.
128.3: Your wife will be like a fruit - bearing vine In the innermost parts of your house. Your sons will be like slips of olive trees all around your table.
128.4: Look! That is how the able - bodied man will be blessed Who fears Jehovah.
128.5: Jehovah will bless you out of Zion. See also the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
128.6: And see the sons of your sons. May there be peace upon Israel.

129.1: " Long enough they have shown hostility to me from my youth, " Let Israel now say,
129.2: " Long enough they have shown hostility to me from my youth; Yet they have not prevailed over me.
129.3: Plowmen have plowed upon my very back; They have lengthened their furrows. "
129.4: Jehovah is righteous. He has cut in pieces the ropes of the wicked ones.
129.5: They will be ashamed and turn themselves back, All those hating Zion.
129.6: They will become like green grass of the roofs, Which before it has been torn out has dried up,
129.7: With which the reaper has not filled his own hand, Nor anyone gathering sheaves his own bosom.
129.8: Nor have those passing by said: " The blessing of Jehovah be upon YOU men. We have blessed YOU in the name of Jehovah. "

130.1: Out of the depths I have called upon you, O Jehovah.
130.2: O Jehovah, do hear my voice. May your ears prove to be attentive to the voice of my entreaties.
130.3: If errors were what you watch, O Jah, O Jehovah, who could stand?
130.4: For there is the I [ true] forgiveness with you, In order that you may be feared.
130.5: I have hoped, O Jehovah, my soul has hoped, And for his word I have waited.
130.6: My soul I [ has waited] for Jehovah More than watchmen for the morning, Watching for the morning.
130.7: Let Israel keep waiting for Jehovah. For there is loving - kindness with Jehovah, And abundantly so is there redemption with him.
130.8: And he himself will redeem Israel out of all his errors.

131.1: O Jehovah, my heart has not been haughty, Nor have my eyes been lofty; Nor have I walked in things too great, Nor in things too wonderful for me.
131.2: Surely I have soothed and quieted my soul Like a weanling upon his mother. My soul is like a weanling upon me.
131.3: Let Israel wait for Jehovah From now on and to time indefinite.

132.1: Remember, O Jehovah, concerning David All his humiliations;
132.2: How he swore to Jehovah, How he vowed to the Powerful One of Jacob:
132.3: " I will not go into the tent of my house. I will not go up on the divan of my grand lounge,
132.4: I will not give sleep to my eyes, Nor slumber to my own beaming eyes,
132.5: Until I find a place for Jehovah, A grand tabernacle for the Powerful One of Jacob. "
132.6: Look! We have heard it in Eph'ra·thah, We have found it in the fields of the forest.
132.7: Let us come into his grand tabernacle; Let us bow down at his footstool.
132.8: Do arise, O Jehovah, to your resting - place, You and the ark of your strength.
132.9: Let your priests themselves be clothed with righteousness, And let your own loyal ones cry out joyfully.
132.10: On account of David your servant, Do not turn back the face of your anointed one.
132.11: Jehovah has sworn to David, Truly he will not draw back from it: " Of the fruitage of your belly I shall set on your throne.
132.12: If your sons will keep my covenant And my reminders that I shall teach them, Their sons also forever Will sit upon your throne. "
132.13: For Jehovah has chosen Zion; He has longed for it as a dwelling for himself:
132.14: " This is my resting - place forever; Here I shall dwell, for I have longed for it.
132.15: Its provisions I shall bless without fail. Its poor ones I shall satisfy with bread.
132.16: And its priests I shall clothe with salvation; And its loyal ones will without fail cry out joyfully.
132.17: There I shall cause the horn of David to grow. I have set in order a lamp for my anointed one.
132.18: His enemies I shall clothe with shame; But upon him his diadem will flourish. "

133.1: Look! How good and how pleasant it is For brothers to dwell together in unity!
133.2: It is like the good oil upon the head, That is running down upon the beard, Aaron's beard, That is running down to the collar of his garments.
133.3: It is like the dew of Her'mon That is descending upon the mountains of Zion. For there Jehovah commanded the blessing I [ to be], I [ Even] life to time indefinite.

134.1: O bless Jehovah, All YOU servants of Jehovah, YOU who are standing in the house of Jehovah during the nights.
134.2: Raise YOUR hands in holiness And bless Jehovah.
134.3: May Jehovah bless you out of Zion, He the Maker of heaven and earth.

135.1: Praise Jah, YOU people! Praise the name of Jehovah, Offer praise, O servants of Jehovah,
135.2: YOU who are standing in the house of Jehovah, In the courtyards of the house of our God.
135.3: Praise Jah, for Jehovah is good. Make melody to his name, for it is pleasant.
135.4: For Jah has chosen even Jacob for himself, Israel for his special property.
135.5: For I myself well know that Jehovah is great, And our Lord is more than all I [ other] gods.
135.6: Everything that Jehovah delighted I [ to do] he has done In the heavens and in the earth, in the seas and all the watery deeps.
135.7: He is causing vapors to ascend from the extremity of the earth; He has made even sluices for the rain; He is bringing forth the wind from his storehouses,
135.8: He who struck down the firstborn ones of Egypt, Both man and beast.
135.9: He sent signs and miracles into the midst of you, O Egypt, Upon Phar'aoh and upon all his servants;
135.10: He who struck down many nations And killed potent kings,
135.11: Even Si'hon the king of the Am'or·ites And Og the king of Ba'shan And all the kingdoms of Ca'naan,
135.12: And who gave their land as an inheritance, An inheritance to Israel his people.
135.13: O Jehovah, your name is to time indefinite. O Jehovah, your memorial is to generation after generation.
135.14: For Jehovah will plead the cause of his people, And he will feel regret even over his servants.
135.15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of the hands of earthling man.
135.16: A mouth they have, but they can speak nothing; Eyes they have, but they can see nothing;
135.17: Ears they have, but they can give ear to nothing. Also there exists no spirit in their mouth.
135.18: Those making them will become just like them, Everyone who is trusting in them.
135.19: O house of Israel, do YOU men bless Jehovah. O house of Aaron, do YOU men bless Jehovah.
135.20: O house of Le'vi, do YOU men bless Jehovah. YOU fearers of Jehovah, bless Jehovah.
135.21: Blessed out of Zion be Jehovah, Who is residing in Jerusalem. Praise Jah, YOU people!

136.1: Give thanks to Jehovah, O YOU people, for he is good: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.2: Give thanks to the God of the gods: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.3: Give thanks to the Lord of the lords: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.4: To the Doer of wonderful, great things by himself: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.5: To the One making the heavens with understanding: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.6: To the One laying out the earth above the waters: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.7: To the One making the great lights: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.8: Even the sun for dominion by day: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.9: The moon and the stars for combined dominion by night: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.10: To the One striking down Egypt in their firstborn ones: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.11: And the One bringing Israel out of the midst of them: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.12: By a strong hand and by an arm stretched out: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.13: To the One severing the Red Sea into parts: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.14: And who caused Israel to pass through the middle of it: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.15: And who shook off Phar'aoh and his military force into the Red Sea: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.16: To the One making his people walk through the wilderness: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.17: To the One striking down great kings: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.18: And who proceeded to kill majestic kings: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.19: Even Si'hon the king of the Am'or·ites: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.20: And Og the king of Ba'shan: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.21: And who gave their land as an inheritance: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.22: An inheritance to Israel his servant: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.23: Who during our low condition remembered us: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.24: And who repeatedly tore us away from our adversaries: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.25: The One giving food to all flesh: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite;
136.26: Give thanks to the God of the heavens: For his loving - kindness is to time indefinite.

137.1: By the rivers of Babylon - there we sat down. We also wept when we remembered Zion.
137.2: Upon the poplar trees in the midst of her We hung our harps.
137.3: For there those holding us captive asked us for the words of a song, And those mocking us - for rejoicing: " SING for us one of the songs of Zion. "
137.4: How can we sing the song of Jehovah Upon foreign ground?
137.5: If I should forget you, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand be forgetful.
137.6: Let my tongue stick to my palate, If I were not to remember you, If I were not to make Jerusalem ascend Above my chief cause for rejoicing.
